sa: यदि पञ्चदशे वर्षे राघवः पुनरेष्यति। जह्याद् राज्यं च कोशं च भरतो नोपलक्ष्यते॥
en: If after the expiration of the five and ten years, Rāghava does return, it does not appear likely that Bharata will renounce the kingdom and the exchequer.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु भगवान् वसिष्ठो मुनिपुङ्गवः॥ विश्वामित्रेण धर्मात्मा प्रत्युवाच महीपतिम्।
en: Thus addressed by Viśvāmitra, the righteous and adorable Vasiştha best of ascetics, replied to that lord of earth.

sa: ततस्तदमृतास्वादं गृध्रराजेन भाषितम्। निशम्य वदता हृष्टास्ते वचः प्लवगर्षभाः॥
en: Then hearing that ambrosial speech of the vulture-king, the monkey-chiefs, being delighted, kept on parleying (on that topic).

sa: अहं निदेशं भवतो यथोक्तमनुपालयन् ॥ चतुर्दश समा वत्स्ये वने वनचरैः सह। मा विमर्शो वसुमती भरताय प्रदीयताम्॥
en: Obeying the mandate that you have issued, I will dwell in the forest for fourteen years in the company of the rangers of the woods. Do you without feeling any compunction confer the earth on Bharata.

sa: पत्रं मूलं फलं यत्तु अल्पं वा यदि वा बहु। दास्यसे स्वयमाहृत्य तन्मेऽमृतरसोपमम्॥
en: Fruits, roots and leaves which you will bring yourself and give me, be they great or small in quantity, shall be to me like to the ambrosiajuice.

sa: एतान् वित्रासितान् पश्य बर्हिणः प्रियदर्शनान्। एवमापततः शैलमधिवासं पतत्रिणः॥
en: And behold these beauteous peacocks, which, being frightened, take refuge in the mountain, the home of feathered tribes.

sa: स्वयं तु भार्यां कौमारी चिरमध्युषितां सतीम्। शैलूष इव मां राम परेभ्यो दातुमिच्छसि॥
en: Do you, like to an ordinary actor, wish to hand me over to others, who am chaste, pure as a virgin, and long held in conjugal affection?

sa: जाम्बवान् वानरश्रेष्ठः सह सर्वैः प्लवङ्गमैः। भूतलात् सहसोत्थाय गृध्रराजानमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then Jāmbavān-foremost of monkeystogether with all the monkeys, arising suddenly from the ground, spoke to the vulture-king, saying,

sa: इयमाकाशगङ्गा च यस्यां पुत्रं हुताशनः। जनयिष्यति देवानां सेनापतिमरिंदमम्॥
en: This is the celestial Gangă she on whom Hutaśana will beget a son-the foe-subduing generalissimo of the celestials.

sa: ततो दशरथः प्राप्य पायसं देवनिर्मितम्। बभूव परमप्रीतः प्राप्य वित्तमिवाधनः॥ ततस्तदद्भुतप्रख्यं भूतं परमभास्वरम्। संवर्तयित्वा तत् कर्म तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Then Daśaratha, having received that divinely prepared Pāyasa, waxed exceeding glad; like that of a pauper attaining plenty. Then that highly effulgent being of a wonderful form, having performed that mission of his, vanished even there.

sa: गजपुष्पीमिमां फुल्लामुत्पाट्य शुभलक्षणाम्। कुरु लक्ष्मण कण्ठेऽस्य सुग्रीवस्य महात्मनः॥।
en: O Lakşmaņa, plucking this auspicious Gaja flower, do you put it round the neck of the highsouled Sugriva.

sa: एवमुक्ता वसिष्ठेन प्रत्युवाच विनीतवत्। वचनं वचनज्ञा सा ब्रह्मर्षिमतुलप्रभम्॥
en: Thus addressed by Vasistha, that cognizant of words humbly said in reply to that Brahmarși of incomparable power.

sa: ततस्तु राजा प्रतिवीक्ष्य ताः स्त्रियः प्ररूढगर्भाः प्रतिलब्धमानसः। बभूव हृष्टिस्त्रिदिवे यथा हरिः सुरेन्द्रसिद्धर्षिगणाभिपूजितः॥
en: The king, beholding those wives of his bearing children, obtained his desire and became delighted; Vişnu, while being worshipped by the Siddhas and the ascetics. even as

sa: अस्य रूपस्य ते युक्ता भार्याहं वरवर्णिनी। मया सह सुखं सर्वान् दण्डकान् विचरिष्यसि।७।।
en: I am fit to be your wife possessed of transcendental grace, having regard to this beauty of yours. And with me you will happily range these Dandakas.

sa: यत्र जातो महातेजाः कार्तिकेयोऽग्निसम्भवः। अथोमां च शिवं चैव देवाः सर्षिगणास्तथा॥ पूजयामासुरत्यर्थं सुप्रीतमनसस्तदा।
en: Here sprang from Fire Kārtikeya of mighty energy. And thereupon the celestials and the saints, with gratified hearts, began to pay enthusiastic adorations to Uma and Siva.

sa: रामप्रव्राजनं चैव देवि याचस्व तं वरम्। एवं सेत्स्यन्ति पुत्रस्य सर्वार्थास्तव कामिनि ॥
en: Do you, therefore, O worshipful one, demand even the banishment of Rāma; for by this it is, O damsel, all interests will be secured to your son.

sa: कस्त्वं किं वर्तसे ब्रह्मज्ञातुमिच्छामहे वयम्। एकस्त्वं विजने दूरे वने चरसि शंस नः॥
en: Who are you? And where are you going, O Brahman? We wish to learn all this. And why is it that you range alone this far-off forest?

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच दमयन्ती ततो दृष्ट्वा पुण्यश्लोकं नराधिपम्। उन्मत्तवदनुन्मत्ता देवने गतचेतसम्॥ भयशोकसमाविष्टा राजन् भीमसुता ततः। चिन्तयामास तत् कार्यं सुमहत् पार्थिवं प्रति॥
en: Brihadshava said : Damayanti beheld the righteous king to be maddened at the gambling and deprived of his reason. Thereupon, O Monarch, the daughter of Bhima was overwhelmed with terror and grief and meditated upon the seriousness of the matter regarding the king, her husband.

sa: तथा फलं वृत्तमथो विचित्रं समाहरत् पाणिना दक्षिणेन। तद् भूमिमासाद्य पुनः पुनश्च समुत्पतत्यद्भुतरूपमुच्चैः॥
en: He carried in his right hand a wonderful globular fruit which reached the ground and again and again rose up to the sky in a wonderful way.

sa: उष्य द्वादशरात्रं तु पूतात्मा च भवेन्नरः। तत एव च गायत्र्याः स्थानं त्रैलोक्यपूजितम्॥
en: Living there for twelve nights a man becomes purified in his soul. Then one should go to the region of Gayatri adored by all the three worlds.

sa: द्रोणं द्रौणिं च साधु त्वं पितापुत्रौ महारथौ। स्तुहि स्तुत्यावुभौ भीष्म सततं द्विजसत्तमौ॥
en: O Bhishma, praise always Drona and his son (Ashvathama),who are, both father and son, worthy of praise, who are great carwarriors, and who are best of Brahmanas.

sa: यथा च भीमो व्रजति तन्मे निगदतः शृणु। बाह्वोर्बले नास्ति समो ममेति भरतर्षभ।॥
en: Hear, I tell you, why Bhima goes in this way. O best of the Bharata race, thinking “There is none equal to me in strength of arms."

sa: तस्मै चार्घ्यं यथान्यायमानीय पृथिवीपतिः। प्राञ्जलिः प्रयतो भूत्वा पप्रच्छागमनेऽर्थिताम्॥
en: Having duly offered the Arghya, the king with joined hands, submissively inquired the reason of the Rishi's arrival.

sa: अभेद्यानि ततः सर्वे समनह्यन्त भारत। जाम्बूनदविचित्राणि कवचानि महारथाः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, those great carwarriors then put on impenetrable armours that were a decked with gold.

sa: भीमस्य राज्ञः सा दत्ता वीरबाहोरहं पुनः। त्वं जाता मया दृष्टा दशार्णेषु पितुहे॥
en: She was given to king Bhima and myself was given to Virabahu. I saw you were born at our father's palace in the country of the Dasharmas.

sa: यमास्थितः सप्त जघान पूगान् दितेः सुतानां नमुचेनिहन्ता। तमिन्द्रवाहं समुपेत्य पार्था: प्रदक्षिणं चक्रुरदीनसत्त्वाः॥
en: Beholding that car of Indra, placed in which the slayer of Namuchi had destroyed seven battalions of Diti's sons, those Parthas with rich spirits, went round it.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच सा तेन च समाधूता दुःखेन च तपस्विनी। पतिता विललापेदं सभायामतथोचिता॥
en: Vaishampayana said Dragged with greater force the afflicted and ascetic lady (Draupadi) who did not deserve such treatment, fell on the ground and wept in the assembly.

sa: स शूरसेनान् कात्स्न्र्येन पूर्वमेवाजयत् प्रभुः। मत्स्यराजं च कौरव्यो वशे चक्रे बलाद् बली॥
en: That powerful descendant of Kuru, the lord (Sahadeva), strong in his own strength, vanquished the Shurasenas at the very outset. He then subjugated the king of Matsya.

sa: ततस्तान् परिविश्वस्तान् वसतः पाण्डुनन्दनान्। ब्राह्मणा बहवस्तत्र समन्तात् पर्यवारयन्॥
en: While those sons of Pandu were securely dwelling at that place they were surrounded by multitudes of Brahmanas.

sa: स लोकान् प्राप्तवानन्द्रान् कर्मणा तेन भारत। सलोकतां तस्य गच्छेत् पयोष्ण्यां य उपस्पृशेत्॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, he obtained the region of Indra by his that act. He who bathes in the Payoshini goes to the region obtained by him.

sa: लोपामुद्रोवाच ईशोऽसि तपसा सर्वं समाहर्तुं तपोधन। क्षणेन जीवलोके यद् वसु किंचन विद्यते॥
en: Lopamudra said : O great ascetic, by your ascetic prowess you can in a moment bring here all the wealth that exists in the world of men.

sa: वङ्गाः कलिङ्गा मगधास्ताम्रलिप्ताः सपुण्ड्रकाः। दौवालिकाः सागरकाः पत्रोर्णाः शैशवास्तथा।॥
en: The Vangas, the Kalingas, the Magadhas, the Tamraliptas, the Sapundrakas the Dauvalikas, the Sagarakas, the Patrornas, the Shaishavas,

sa: तपश्च ब्रह्मचर्यं च यज्ञः स्वाध्याय एव च। दानमार्जवमेतानि यदि स्युरफलानि वै॥ नाचरिष्यन् परेधर्म परे परतरे च ये। विप्रलम्भोऽयमत्यन्तं यदि स्युरफलाः क्रियाः॥ ऋषयश्चैव देवाश्च गन्धर्वासुरराक्षसाः। ईश्वराः कस्य हेतोस्ते चरेयुर्धर्ममादृताः॥
en: If devout penances, life of celibacy, sacrifice, the study of the Vedas, charity and honesty-these were fruitless then people would not have practised virtues, generation after generation. If all the action had been fruitless a terrible confusion would have set in. Why do the Rishis, the gods the Gandharvas, the Asuras and the Rakshasas who are lords of themselves, with love practise virtues?

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच गुरुभिर्नियमैर्युक्तो भरतो नाम पावकः। अग्निः पुष्टिमतिर्नाम तुष्टः पुष्टिं प्रयच्छति। भरत्येष प्रजाः सर्वास्ततो भरत उच्यते॥
en: Markandeya said : The fire named Bharata was bound by severe rules of asceticism; Pushtimati is his another name; when he is satisfied he grants pushti (development) to all creatures and therefore he is called Bharata.

sa: ततस्तमाश्रमं रम्यं नरनारायणाश्रितम्। ददृशुः पाण्डवा राजन् सहिता द्विजपुङ्गवैः॥
en: O king, the Pandavas, accompanied by those best of Brahmanas, saw the charming hermitage of Nara and Narayana.

sa: हिरण्यपुरमित्येवं ख्यायते नगरं महत्। रक्षितं कालकेयैश्च पौलोमैश्च महासुरैः॥
en: This mighty city is called Hiranyapura and is guarded by the powerful Asuras, the Kalakeyas and the Paulomas.

sa: तथा तर्कयतस्तस्य फाल्गुनस्याथ मातलिः। संनतः प्रस्थितो भूत्वा वाक्यमर्जुनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Thereupon while Falguni was thus thinking about the car, Matali, descending and bending himself low, said to Arjuna.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ते तु वचने धर्मराजेन धीमता। धिग्धिगित्येव वृद्धानां सभ्यानां निःसृता गिरः॥
en: Vaishampayana said When this was said by the wise Dharmaraja (Yudhisthira), “Fie! Fie!" were the words uttered by all the elders that were present in the assembly.

sa: साध्यान् रुद्रांस्तथाऽऽदित्यान् गुह्यकान् पितरस्तदा। सर्पान् नागान् सुपर्णाश्च वसूनप्यश्विनावपि॥
en: The Saddhya, the Rudra, the Adityas, the Guhyakas, the Pitris, the Nagas, the birds, the Vasus, the Asmas,

sa: षष्टिः पुत्रसहस्राणि शूराः परमदर्पिताः। एकस्यां सम्भविष्यन्ति पल्यां नरवरोत्तम॥ ते चैव सर्वे सहिताः क्षयं यास्यन्ति पार्थिव। एको वंशधरः शूर एकस्यां सम्भविष्यति॥
en: O foremost of men, sixty thousand heroic and proud sons will be born in one of your two wives. O ruler of men, they will all together meet with destruction. In the other wife will be born a heroic son who will perpetuate your race."

sa: सर्वं पश्याम्यहं राजस्तस्य कुक्षौ महात्मनः। चरमाणः फलाहारः कृत्स्नं जगदिदं विभो॥ अन्तःशरीरे तस्याहं वर्षाणामधिकं शतम्। न च पश्यामि तस्याहं देहस्यान्तं कदाचन॥
en: O king, I saw them all in the stomach of that high-souled one. O lord, living on fruits, wandering over the entire universe which was there, I lived within his body for many hundred years. But I did not see the end of his body.

sa: ततो मध्यमकक्षायां ददर्श रथमास्थितम्। ऋतुपर्णं महीपालं सहवार्ष्णेयबाहुकम्॥ वै
en: From the central portion of the mansion she saw on the car king Rituparna, with Varshneya and Bahuka.

sa: त्रिदशांश्चाप्यबाधन्त तथा गन्धर्वराक्षसान्। सर्वाणि चैव भूतानि शूराः समरशालिनः॥
en: Those heroes, ever fond of fight, chased even the celestials, the Gandharvas the Rakshashas and all other creatures.

sa: व्याध उवाच अनतिक्रमणीया वै ब्राह्मणा मे द्विजोत्तम। शृणु सर्वमिदं वृत्तं पूर्वदेहे ममानघ॥
en: The Fowler said: O foremost of the Brahmanas, O sinless one, Brahmanas are worthy of all respect from me, hear about the story of my previous existence.

sa: वारुणी दिशमागम्य यवनान् बर्बरांस्तथा। नृपान् पश्चिमभूमिस्थान् दापयामास वैकरान्॥
en: Having then gone to the abode of Varuna, he made all the Yavana and Barbara kings pay tributes.

sa: तव भीम सुतेनाहमतिभीमपराक्रम। अक्षतः सह पाञ्चाल्या गच्छेयं गन्धमादनम्॥
en: O greatly powerful hero, by your strength of arins I shall go with the Panchala princess to Gandhamadana.

sa: गतेषु पार्थिवेन्द्रेषु सर्वेषु ब्राह्मणेषु च। युधिष्ठिरमुवाचेदं वासुदेवः प्रतापवान्॥
en: On the departure of all the kings and the Brahmanas, the powerful Vasudeva (Krishna) thus spoke to Yudhishthira.

sa: स तैः प्रीत्याथ सत्कारमुपनीतं महर्षिभिः। प्रयतः प्रतिगृह्याथधर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Dharmaraja Yudhishthira gladly received with subdued soul the offerings offered by the great Rishis for his reception. son

sa: ततो हलहलाशब्दस्तत्रासीद् घोरदर्शनः। तदद्भुततमं लोको वीक्ष्य सर्वे महीभृतः। शशंसुद्रौपदीं तत्र कुत्सन्तो धृतराष्ट्रजम्॥
en: Thereupon there rose a great uproar. All the kings (present there), seeing this most extraordinary sight in the world, applauded Draupadi and endured the son of Dhritarashtra.

sa: स्कन्धमारोप्य भद्रं ते मध्येऽस्माकं विहायसा। गच्छ नीचिकया गत्या यथा चैनां न पीडयेः॥
en: On your shoulder and go with us adopting a course not far overhead, so that you may not make her feel uneasy. Let blessings be on you.

sa: दमयन्त्यास्तु तद् वाक्यं वार्ष्णेयो नलसारथिः। न्यवेदयशेषेण नलामात्येषु मुख्यशः॥
en: Varshneya the charioteer of Nala, told in detail these words of Damayanti to the chief counsellors of Nala.

sa: अभितर्जयमानाश्च रुवन्तश्च महारवान्। न मोहं भीमसेनस्य ददृशुः सर्वराक्षसाः॥
en: Although uttering both loud yells and cries of victory, the Rakshasas did not see Bhima deprived of senses.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अनुज्ञातांस्तान् विदित्वा धृतराष्ट्रेण धीमता। राजन् दुःशासनः क्षिप्रं जगाम भ्रातरं प्रति॥
en: Vaishampayana said O king, having learnt that the Pandavas had been commanded by the wise Dhritarashtra to return to their capital Dushasana soon went to his brother.

sa: सुखोदयाय तत् सर्वं श्रेयसे च तवानघ। यच्च किंचित् त्वया लोके दृष्टं स्थावरजङ्गमम्॥
en: O sinless one, know all that was for your happiness and good fortune. Whatever worlds with their mobile and immobile beings you have seen (within my stomach).

sa: वह्निमेव प्रवक्ष्यामि भक्षयिष्यामि वा विषम्। अपो वापि प्रवेक्ष्यामि न हि शक्ष्यामि जीवितुम्॥
en: Duryodhana said I shall throw myself into the fire, or I shall drink the poison, or I shall drown myself in water. I am unable to live.

sa: सुमहानपि मत्स्यस्तु स मनोनयतस्तदा। आसीद् यथेष्टहार्यश्च स्पर्शगन्धसुखस्य वै॥
en: Notwithstanding its huge size Manu easily carried it and its touch and smell were also pleasant to him.

sa: सा सेनोपविष्टं राजानं परिवार्यातिष्ठत्। पर्याश्वस्तश्च राजा तयैव सह शिबिकया प्रायादवघोटितया स स्वं नगरमनुप्राप्य रहसि तया सहास्ते॥
en: Seeing the kings, the soldiers stood surrounded him. Chcered by the arrival of his soldiers, the king entered a Palakin and went to his city. Arriving at his own city, he lived with her in privacy.

sa: रामस्य च प्रभावेण तीर्थं राजन् कृतं पुरा। तल्लौहित्यं समासाद्य विन्द्याद् बहु सुवर्णकम्॥
en: O king, going then to Tollouhitya, Tirtha created in the days of yore by the prowess of Rama, one obtains the fruits of giving away much gold.

sa: अयुतं प्रयुतं चैव शङ्ख पद्मं तथार्बुदम्। खर्वं शनिखर्वं च महापद्मं च कोटयः॥ मध्यं चैव परार्धं च सपरं चात्र पण्यताम्। एतन्मम धनं राजंस्तेन दीव्याम्यहं त्वया॥
en: You can bet (with me) tens of thousands, and millions, tens of millions and billions, hundreds of billions and trillions, tens of trillions and hundreds of trillions, tens of quadrillions and hundreds of quadrillions and even more. O king, I will bet such wealth. With this wealth at stake I shall play with you.

sa: तेजसा वर्चसा चैव युक्तं भार्गवनन्दनम्। स वर्धमानस्तेजस्वी वेदस्याध्यनेन च॥ बहूनृषीन् महातेजाः पाण्डवेयात्यवर्तत।
en: This descendant of Bhrigu was endued with both splendour and grace. He grew in years as well as in strength; and he excelled all in the Vedas.

sa: अतीव मुदितो राजा भ्राजमानोंऽशुमानिव॥ अरञ्जयत् प्रजा वीरोधर्मेण परिपालयन्।
en: The warlike monarch, resplendent as the sun, was exceedingly glad to rule and maintain his subjects most righteously.

sa: एवं प्रकारैर्बहुभिर्दैवेनाक्रम्य हस्तिभिः। राजन् विनिहतं सर्वं समृद्धं सार्थमण्डलम्॥
en: O king! thus accidentally attacked by a large number of elephants, the good merchants underwent a great loss.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच इन्द्रस्तस्या वचः श्रुत्वा दुःखितोऽचिन्तयद् भृशम्। अस्या देव्याः पतिर्नास्ति यादृशं सम्प्रभाषते॥
en: Having heard her these words, he (Indra) became sorry and pensive. (He thought), “There is no husband for this lady like the one she desires to possess.

sa: एतत् प्रस्रवणं पुण्यमिन्द्रस्य मनुजेश्वर। यत्रधाता विधाता च वरुणश्चोर्ध्वमागताः॥
en: O ruler of men, this is the sacred spring of Indra where Dhata, Vidhata and Varuna rose upwards.

sa: युधिष्ठिरः सहामात्यः प्रविवेश पुरोत्तमम्। दुर्योधनो महाराज शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः। सभायां रमणीयायां तत्रैवास्ते नराधिप॥
en: Yudhishthira then with his ministers entered his excellent palace. O great king, Duryodhana and the son of Subala, Shakuni, (then) lived in that charming Sabha (assembly hall).

sa: पौलस्त्यंधनदं युद्धे च आह्वयति दर्पितः। नलिन्यां कदनं कृत्वा निहन्ता यक्षरक्षसाम्॥ तं शंससि भयाविष्टमापन्नमरिसूदनम्। एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं परं कौतूहलं हि मे॥ वैशम्पायन उवाच बह्वाश्चर्ये वने तेषां वसतामुग्धन्विनाम्। प्राप्तानामाश्रमाद् राजन् राजर्षवृषपर्वणः॥
en: That tormentor of foes, who in a defiant spirit challenged even the son of Pulastya, the dispenser of wealth, to a single combat and who encountering the Yakshas and the Rakshasas at the lotus lake (of Kubera) destroyed them (wholesale) has been described by you as seized with fear and dismay. All this I am desirous of hearing; great indeed is my curiosity.

sa: स दास्यति यथाकालमुचिता यस्य या भृतिः। स चेद् यथोचितां वृत्तिं न दद्यान्मनुजेश्वरः॥ अस्मत्प्रियहितार्थाय पाञ्चाल्यो वः प्रदास्यति॥
en: He will give them in due time their proper allowance. If that ruler of men does not give them their proper allowances. The king of Panchala will give them the allowance for our satisfaction and welfare.

sa: ततो हतारिः सगणः सुखं वै प्रशाधि कृत्स्नं त्रिदिवं दिविष्ठः। त्वष्ट्रा तथोक्तस्तु पुरंदरस्तद् वज्रं प्रहृष्टः प्रयतो ह्यगृहणात्॥
en: O chief of the celestials, killing the foe rule happily the kingdom of heaven with your own friends." Having been thus addressed by Tvashtri Purandara (Indra) cheerfully took the Vajra from his hands with proper respects.

sa: बृहदश्व उवाच प्रशान्ते तु पुरे हृष्टे सम्प्रवृत्ते महोत्सवे। महत्या सेनया राजा दमयन्तीमुपानयत्॥
en: Brihadashva said: When the great festivities began in the city which was full of joy, the king with a large army brought Damayanti (back to his capital).

sa: इत्युक्तवति धर्मज्ञे धर्मराजे युधिष्ठिरे। उवाचेदं वचो भीष्मस्ततः कुरुपितामहः॥
en: When Dharmaraja Yudhishthira, learned in morality, said this, the grandsire of the Kurus Bhishma thus spoke to him.

sa: तेजसा तव तेजश्च विष्णुराप्याययिष्यति। विष्णुना च वरो दत्तः पूर्वं मम महीपते॥ यस्तं महासुरं रौद्रं वधिष्यति महीपतिः। तेजस्तं वैष्णवमिति प्रवेक्ष्यति दुरासदम्॥
en: Your energy will be increased by that of Vishnu, the ruler of earth. A boon was granted by Vishnu in the days of yore. Namely that he who will kill this fearful and great Asura would be pervaded by the matchless energy of Vishnu himself.

sa: एष चेज्जनयेद् गर्भ सोऽस्या देव्याः पतिर्भवेत्। एवं संचिन्त्य भगवान् ब्रह्मलोकं तदा गतः॥
en: If he too beget a son, that son may become the husband of this damsel. “Having thus, though the exalted one went to the abode of Brahma.

sa: कृत्स्नं पञ्चनदं चैव तथैवामरपर्वतम्। उत्तरज्योतिषं चैव तथा दिव्यकटं पुरम्॥ द्वारपालं च तरसा वशे चक्रे महाद्युतिः। रामठान् हारहूणांश्च प्रतीच्याश्चैव ये नृपाः॥
en: The whole country, called after the five rivers, the mountains called Amara, the country called Uttarajyotisha, the city of Divyakata and the tribe called Dvarapala, the Ramathas, the Harahunas, and the various other kings of the west were all subjugated by the greatly effulgent hero.

sa: तव चैव प्रभावेण स्वर्गं यास्यन्ति सागराः। पौत्रश्च ते त्रिपथगां त्रिदिवादानयिष्यति॥ पावनार्थं सागराणां तोषयित्वा महेश्वरम्। हयं नयस्व भद्रं ते यज्ञियं नरपुङ्गव॥
en: Through your might, the sons of Sagara will go to heaven and your grand-son will bring the three-coursed river (the Ganges) from heaven, by gratifying Maheshvara in order to purify the sons of Sagara. O foremost of men, be blessed; take (back) the sacrificial horse.

sa: न तेऽभिगमनं ब्रह्मन् मोघमेतद् भविष्यति। पुत्रो ममायं भगवन् कुवलाश्व इति स्मृतः॥ धृतिमान् क्षिप्रकारी च वीर्येणाप्रतिमो भुवि।
en: "O Brahmana, your this visit will not be in vain. O holy one, my this son, known by the name of Kuvalashva, is both active and steady; and he is also matchless in prowess on earth.

sa: विक्रम्य कौशिकं खङ्गं मोक्षयित्वा ग्रहं रिपोः। आक्रन्दद् भीमसेनं वै येन यातो महाबलः॥
en: He snatched by force the sword named Kaushika from the hand of the enemy and loudly calling Bhimasena went in the direction that mighty Rakshasa had gone.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच मार्कण्डेयवचः श्रुत्वा कुरूणां प्रवरो नृपः॥ उवाच वचनं धीमान् परमं परमद्युतिः।
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard these words of Markandeya, the foremost of the Kurus, the greatly intelligent and highly effulgent king (Yudhishthira) spoke these words of wisdom.

sa: तमापतन्तं वेगेन प्रभिन्नमिव वारणम्। वत्सदन्तैस्त्रिभिः पार्श्वे भीमसेनः समार्दयत्॥
en: Beholding him approach with the fury of a maddened elephant, Bhimasena pierced his sides with three choice arrows.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु तानक्षाञ्छकुनिः प्रत्यदीव्यत। जितमित्येव शकुनियुधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having said this, Shakuni cast the dice and thus spoke to Yudhisthira, Lo, I have won!"

sa: तत्रोपदिष्टमिन्द्रेण दिव्यमस्त्रं विशोषणम्। दीप्तं प्राहिणवं घोरमशुष्यत् तेन तज्जलम्॥
en: Thereupon, I discharged that terrible, flaming and celestials weapon, Vishoshana, learnt from Indra, which dried the water up.

sa: कृतमेव त्वया सर्वं मम वानरपुङ्गवा स्वस्ति तेऽस्तु महाबाहो कामये त्वां प्रसीद मे॥
en: "O foremost of monkeys, O mighty-armed hero, I consider all this already performed by you. Good come to you. I ask you to be pleased with ine.

sa: पाण्डोः सुता यादृशा मे तादृशास्तव भारत। दीना इतीव मे बुद्धिरभिपन्नाद्य तान् प्रति॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, your sons are as dear to me as those of Pandu. But as they are now in distress, my mind yarns for them.

sa: न हि मानं प्रशंसन्ति निकृतौ कितवस्य हि। शकुने मैव नो जैषीरमार्गेण नृशंसवत्॥
en: O Shakuni, the wise men do not praise the pride that gamesters feel in deceitful play. Do not like a cruel man defeat us by deceitful means.

sa: क्रीडतो भोजराजस्य एष रैवतके गिरौ। हत्वा बद्ध्वा च तान् सर्वानुपायात् स्वपुरं पुरा॥
en: When the Bhoja king was sporting on the Raivataka hill, he killed many of that king''. attendant and carried away many in chains to his own city.

sa: इदं हि वासो यदि वेदृशानां मनस्विनां रौरवमाहवेषु। अदीक्षितानामजिनानि यद्वद् बलीयसां पश्यत पाण्डवानाम्॥
en: Though in this dress, the Pandavas appear like wise and powerful men installed in a sacrifice, but see (consider) them as persons not entitled to perform sacrifices.

sa: पाण्डवः परवीरनः सहदेवः प्रतापवान्। ततोऽस्यं सुमहद् युद्धमासीद् भीरुभयंकरम्॥
en: The battle between the chastiser of foes, the powerful Pandava, Sahadeva, and the king (Nila) was very fearful.

sa: न मां प्रीणाति मद्भुक्तं श्रियं दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरे। अति ज्वलन्तीं कौन्तेये विवर्णकरणी मम॥
en: Seeing the prosperity of Yudhishthira, whatever I enjoy does not gratify or please me. The great and splendid prosperity of the son of Kunti makes me pale.

sa: एतासां वीर्यसम्पन्नः शिशु मातिदारुणः। स्कन्दप्रसादजः पुत्रो लोहिताक्षो भयंकरः॥
en: They had a powerful, red-eyed, terrific and very turbulent son, named Shishu, born by the blessings of Skanda.

sa: सौगन्धिकवनं राजंस्ततो गच्छेत मानवः॥
en: O king, a man should then go to Saugandikvana.

sa: लोमश उवाच नृगेण यजमानेन सोमेनेह पुरंदरः। तर्पितः श्रूयते राजन् स तृप्तो मुदमभ्यगात्॥
en: Lomasha said: O King, when Nriga performed sacrifices and gratified Purandara (Indra) with the offer of Soma juice, he became very much gratified and was much pleased.

sa: स तेन कोपेन विदह्यमानः करं करेणाभिनिपीड्य वीरः। विनिःश्वसत्युष्णमतीव घोरं दहन्निवेमान् मम पुत्रपौत्रान्॥
en: That hero, burning in wrath, squeezes his hands and breathes hot and fearful sighs, as if he wants to consume by them all my sons and grandsons.

sa: स वै तत्रावसद् राजा वैदर्भीमनुचिन्तयन्। सायं सायं सदा चेमं श्लोकमेकं जगाद ह॥
en: That king continued to live there in anxiety for the daughter of the king of the Vidharbhas; and every evening he repeated a verse which runs thus:

sa: स सौबलेन सहितस्तथा दुःशासनेन च। उपायं पश्य निपुणं येन गच्छेम तद् वनम्॥
en: Therefore find out some skillful plan with the help of Subala's son (Shakuni) and Duhshasana, by which we may go to the forest (where the Pandavas) are.

sa: ग्रामांश्च घोषांश्च सुतस्य दृष्ट्वा शान्तां च शान्तोऽस्य परः स कोपः। चकार तस्यैव परं प्रसादं विभाण्डको भूमिपतेनरेन्द्र॥
en: Having seen the villages and the cow-pens belonging to his son and also having seen Santa, his great anger was appeased. O ruler of men, thereupon Vibhandaka expressed his great satisfaction with that ruler of earth.

sa: गवां माता तु या प्राज्ञैः कथ्यते सुरभिर्नृप। शकुनिस्तामथारुह्य सह भुङ्क्ते शिशून् भुवि॥
en: O king, Surabhi, who is called the mother of all animals of the bovine species, is ridden by Shakuni who along with her devours children on earth.

sa: यच्च तदुक्मपात्रीभिर्ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सहस्रशः। ह्रियते ते गृहादन्नं संस्कृतं सार्वकामिकम्॥
en: (Formerly) pure food of every kind was taken from your house, on golden plates to thousands of Brahmanas.

sa: दमयन्त्या ब्रुवन्त्यास्तु सर्वमेतदरिंदम्। शोकजं वारि नेत्राभ्यामसुखं प्रास्रवद् बहु॥
en: O chastiser of foes, while Damayanti was speaking all these, tears of sorrow flowed copiously from her eyes.

sa: मां ततो वै द्विगणं रथश्चैव हिरण्मयः। मनोजवौ वाजिनौ च दित्सितं ते महासुर॥
en: O great Asura, to me you have intended to give twice as much and a golden chariot and a couple of horses with the speed of mind.

sa: हनूमानुवाच किमर्थं सरुजस्तेऽहं सुखसुप्तः प्रबोधितः। ननु नाम त्वया कार्या दया भूतेषु जानता॥
en: Hanuman said: Why have you awakened me, ill as I am? I was comfortably asleep. As you have reason, you should certainly show kindness to all creatures.

sa: तावन्योन्यं समाश्लिष्य प्रकर्षन्तौ परस्परम्। उभावपि चकाशेते प्रवृद्धौ वृषभाविव॥
en: Grappling and dragging each other in various ways, they appeared like two infuriated bulls struggling with each other.

sa: न मत्कृते त्वया वीर भी: कार्या वनमन्तिकात्। इयं भूमिः सदास्माकमुचिता वसतां वने।॥
en: "O hero, you need not be anxious for my dwelling in the forest. This forest-land is the proper abode for us who (always) dwell in the forest.

sa: एतद्धि मम कार्याणां परमं हृदि संस्थितम्। कृता तेन तु तुष्टिर्मे सत्कारच भविष्यति॥
en: This is the one act on which my heart is set. If you do it, you will give me the greatest satisfaction and pay your best regards.

sa: तत् कुरुष्व नरव्याघ्र दयां मयि नरर्षभ। आनृशंस्यं परोधर्मस्त्वत्त एव हि मे श्रुतः॥
en: O foremost of men, O the most excellent of persons, be you kind to me. For I have heard from you, that kindness is the chief virtue.”

sa: सोऽभिगम्य महात्मानं भ्राता भ्रातरमग्रजम्। मूर्धा प्रणम्य चरणाविदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Coming to his illustrious eldest brother and bowing his head to his feet, he thus spoke to him.

sa: अश्वमेधो राजसूयः पुण्डरीकोऽथ गोसवः। एतैरपि महायज्ञैरिष्टं ते भूरिदक्षिणैः॥
en: The Ashvamedha, the Rajasuya, Pundarika, the Gosava-all these great sacrifices requiring large gifts have been celebrated by you.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमुक्ता ततः स्वाहा तुष्टा स्कन्देन पूजिता। पावकेन समायुक्ता भर्ना स्कन्दमपूजयत्॥
en: Markandeya said : Having been thus addressed and worshipped by Skanda, Svaha was greatly pleased. Being thus united with her husband Pavaka (Agni), she much honoured Skanda.

sa: दुष्करं पुष्करे गन्तुं दुष्करं पुष्करे तपः। दुष्करं पुष्करे दानं वस्तुं चैव सुदुष्करम्॥
en: It is very difficult to go to Pushkara; it is very difficult to undergo asceticism Pushkara; it is very difficult to give away in charity at Pushkara.

sa: अधर्मचारिणस्तस्य कौरव्यस्य दुरात्मनः। ये शीलमनुवर्तन्ते ते पश्यन्ति पराभवम्॥
en: Those that imitate the conduct of that sinful and wicked Kuru (Duryodhana) are now seeing his own disgrace.

sa: स तप्यमानः सुमहत् तपो योगसमन्वितः। आससाद महात्मानं त्र्यक्षं त्रिपुरमर्दनम्॥ शंकरं भवमीशानं शूलपाणिं पिनाकिनम्। त्र्यम्बकं शिवमुग्रेशं बहुरूपमुमापतिम्॥
en: Being engaged in great austerities and in Yoga and in contemplation, he saw the illustrious three-eyed deity, the chastiser of Tripura, Shankara, Bhava, Ishana, Pinaki, Shulapani, Traymbaka, Shiva, Ugresha of many forms, the husband of Uma.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच ऋष्यशृङ्गः कथं मृग्यामुत्पन्नः काश्यपात्मजः। विरुद्धे योनिसंसर्गे कथं च तपसा युतः॥
en: Yudhishthira said: How was the son of Kashyapa, i Rishyashringa born of a hind? Being born of an irregular intercourse, how was he endued with ascetic merits?

sa: क्व नु त्वं कितवच्छित्त्वा वस्त्रार्धं प्रस्थितो मम। उत्सृज्य विपिने सुप्तामनुरक्तां प्रियां प्रिय॥
en: 'O gambler, O beloved one, did you tear off a half of my cloth and flee away forsaking your dear and devoted wife sleeping in the forest?

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरंधौम्यो गृहीत्वा दक्षिणे करे। प्राची दिशमभिप्रेक्ष्य महर्षिरिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Then the great sage Dhaumya, taking Yudhishthira by the right hand and looking towards the East, said this:

sa: कथंरूपा च सा शान्ता राजपुत्री यतव्रता। लोभयामास या चेतो मृगभूतस्य तस्य वै॥ लोमपादश्च राजर्षिर्यदाश्रूयतधार्मिकः। कथं वै विषये तस्य नावर्षत् पाकशासनः॥
en: What sort of a princess that vow-observing Shanta was, who tempted his heart by becoming at nd? Why did not the chastiser of . foes (Indra) pour rain in the kingdom of the royal sage Lomapada when it is heard that he was very virtuous.

sa: ततः सम्प्रेषयामास रत्नानि विविधानि च। चन्दनागुरुकाष्ठानि दिव्यान्याभरणानि च॥
en: He (Vibhishana) sent to him (Sahadeva) various kinds of jewels and gems, sandal and aloe-woods, many celestials ornaments.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पूजयित्वा च पूजार्हान् ब्रह्मक्षत्रविशेषवित्। सहदेवो नृणां देवः समापद्यत कर्म तत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having worshipped those that deserved worship, then that god among men, Sahadeva, well-acquainted with the difference between a Brahmana and a Kshatriya competed the ceremony.

sa: यत्रैतल्लक्ष्यते सर्प वृत्तं स ब्राह्मणः स्मृतः। यत्रैतन्न भवेत् सर्प तं शूद्रमिति निर्दिशेत्॥
en: And, O serpent, it is asserted that he who is distinguished by these qualities is a Brahmana and he who does not posses them is a Shudra.

sa: स श्रुतर्वाणमादाय नश्वमगमत् ततः। स च तौ विषयस्यान्ते प्रत्यगृहणाद् यथाविधि॥ तयोरय॑ च पाद्यं च ब्रनश्वः प्रत्यवेदयत्। अनुज्ञाप्य च पप्रच्छ प्रयोजनमुपक्रमे॥
en: Taking therefore Shrutarvana with him, he went to Bradhnashva. Having learnt of their arrival at the frontier of his kingdom he received them duly by offering them Arghya and water to wash their feet. He then with their permission inquired the reason of their coming.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच कथं गच्छति कौन्तेयो धर्मपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः। भीमसेनः सव्यसाची माद्रीपुत्रौ च पाण्डवौ॥
en: Dhritarashtra said How does the son of Kunti, and Dharma, Yudhisthira, proceed along? How does Bhimasena also Savyasachi (Arjuna) and the two Pandavas, the sons of Madri?

sa: अष्टाशीतिसहस्राणि स्नातका गृहमेधिनः। त्रिंशद्दासीक एकैको यान् बिभर्ति युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Eighty thousand Snataka Brahmanas, all leading domestic lives, were entertained by Yudhishthira with thirty maid-servants assigned to each.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच भीष्मे द्रोणे कृपे कर्णे द्रोणपुत्रे च भारत। धनुर्वेदश्चतुष्पाद एतेष्वद्य प्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: Yudhishthira said: O descendant of Bharata, the four divisions of the science of arms always dwell in Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, Karna and the son of Drona (Ashvathama).

sa: पाण्डुरेणातपत्रेण ध्रियमाणेन मूर्धनि। दोधूयता चामरेण श्वेतेन च महारथः॥
en: That powerful car-warrior had a white umbrella held over his head, and was fanned with a milk-white yak-tails.

sa: कर्मणामस्य कौन्तेय नान्तं संख्यातुमुत्सहे। शाश्वतस्य पुराणस्य पुरुषस्य युधिष्ठिर॥
en: I dare not, O son of Kunti, enumerate the feats of this Ancient and Eternal Being, O Yudhishthira.

sa: इन्द्र उवाच जानन् यो गामपहरेद् विक्रीयाच्चार्थकारणात्। एतद् विज्ञातुमिच्छामि क्व नु तस्य गतिर्भवेत्॥
en: Indra said I desire to know. O Grandfather, what the end is of his who consciously steals a cow or who sells one from motives of cupidity.

sa: ब्राह्मणो हि महद्भूतं क्षेत्रभूतं युधिष्ठिर। उप्यते तत्र तद् बीजं तद्धि पुण्यफलं महत्॥
en: The Brahmana, O Yudhishthira, is a great Being. He is also a fertile field. Whatever seed is sown on that field yields an abundant crop of merit.

sa: आजेन मासान्ग्रीयन्ते पञ्चैव पितरो नृप। वाराहेण तु षण्मासान् सप्त वै शाकुलेन तु॥
en: With the flesh of the goat, o king, they remain pleased for five months, with becon for six months, and with the flesh of birds for seven.

sa: मन इत्येव भगवांस्तदा प्राह सरस्वती। अहं वै कामधुक् तुभ्यमिति तं प्राह वागथ॥
en: On that occasion, the holy one made this answer, The mind undoubtedly (is superior)! To him Word said, I great you the fruition of all your desires.

sa: यदि धर्म यथाशक्ति जन्मप्रभृति सेवते। ततः स पुरुषो भूत्वा सेवते नित्यदा सुखम्॥
en: If individual soul according to the best of his power, follows virtue from the day of his birth, he them succeeds in enjoying uninterruptedly, when reborn, happiness.

sa: साहं प्रसादये कृष्ण त्वामद्य शिरसा नता। पृथेयं द्रौपदी चैव ताः पश्य पुरुषोत्तम॥
en: Bowing to you with my head, O Krishna, I seek to please you today! See O foremost of men, these two standing here, viz., Pritha and Draupadi.

sa: तमसो मिथुनं सत्त्वं सत्त्वस्य मिथुनं रजः। रजसञ्चापि सत्त्वं स्यात् सत्त्वस्य मिथुनं तमः॥
en: Goodness is also the match of Ignorance. Of goodness the match of Darkness. Goodness is also the match of Darkness, and of Goodness the match is Ignorance.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच दानं बहुविधाकारं शान्तिः सत्यमहिंसितम्। स्वदारतुष्टिश्चोक्ता ते फलं दानस्य चैव यत्॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have described to us the various kinds of gifts, tranquillity of soul, Truth, mercy, contentment with one's married wife, and the merits of gift.

sa: निषेदुस्ते ततः सर्वे पूजां प्राप्य युधिष्ठिरात्। आसनेषु च पुण्येषु बर्हिणेषु वरेषु च॥
en: Having got that worship from Yudhishthira, all of them sat down on sacred seats (made of Kusha grass as also on excellent seats made of peacock feathers.

sa: ब्राह्मण उवाच प्राणेन या सम्भवते शरीरे प्राणादपानं प्रतिपद्यते च। उदानभूता च विसृज्य देहं व्यानेन सर्वं दिवमावृणोति॥
en: The Brahmana said The Word that is made in the body by Prana, then attains to Apana from Prana. Then changed into Udana and coming out of the body, it covers all the quarters, with Vyana.

sa: निहत्य पृथिवीपालान् राज्यं प्राप्तमिदं मया। तव प्रज्ञामुपश्रुत्य वासुदेवान्नरर्षभात्॥
en: Having killed the kings of Earth, I have acquired sovereignty, guided by your wise words communicated through Vasudeva.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच यदिदं तप इत्याहुरुपवासं पृथग्जनाः। तपः स्यादेतदेवेह तपोऽन्यद् वापि किं भवेत्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Some people say that fast is a penance. Is penance really at one with fast or is it not so? Tell me this, O grandfather.

sa: यम उवाच शृणु तत्त्वेन विप्रर्षे प्रदानविधिमुत्तमम्। तिलाः परमकं दानं पुण्यं चैवेह शाश्वतम्॥
en: Yama said Do you hear, O twiceborm Rishi, the excellent ordinances about gifts. The gift of sesame seeds is a very superior gift. It yields everlasting merit.

sa: वर्धते वर्धमानस्य वर्धते च कथं बलम्। निरोधानां निर्गमनं मलानां च पृथक् पृथक्॥
en: How does the strength grow of the growing man? How takes place the escape of all such elements as are not nutritive, and of all impurities separately?

sa: व्यचेष्टत च बालोऽसौ यथोत्साहं यथाबलम्। बभूवुर्मुदिता राजंस्ततस्ता भरतस्त्रियः॥
en: The child began to move according to his energy and power. The Bharata-ladies became all filled with joy.

sa: दैवं तत् तु विजानीमो यन्न शक्यं प्रवाधितुम्॥ दैवं पुरुषकारेण न शक्यमपि बाधितुम्।
en: We know that it was encompassed about by Destiny, and that it was incapable of being counteracted. Destiny is not capable of being resisied by human exertion.

sa: वेदाश्च सोपनिषदो विद्या सावित्र्यथापि च। भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च दधार भगवान् शिवः॥
en: The Vedas with the Upanishads, Vidya, and Savitri, as also, the Past, the Present, and the Future, all came there and were held by the illustrious Shiva.

sa: गम्यतां पुत्र पर्याप्तमेतावत् पूजिता वयम्। राजा यदाह तत् कार्यं त्वया पुत्र पितुर्वचः॥
en: We have been sufficiently honoured and served by you. You should do what the king says. Indeed, O son, you should obey the command of your sire.

sa: एको होकेन सततं युध्यमाने यदि प्रभो॥ न स शक्येत संग्रामे निहन्तुमपि वज्रिणा।
en: If, O lord, he had been encountered, one to one, without intermission, he was incapable of being killed in battle by even the holder of the thunder-bolt.

sa: भीष्म उवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि पुरावृत्तं महाद्युते। नहुषस्य च संवादं महर्षेश्च्यवनस्य च॥
en: Bhishma said I shall, O you of great effulgence, recite to you in this connection an ancient narrative of a conversation between Nahusha and the Rishi Chyavana.

sa: एवंविधं बहु तदा विलपन्तं सुदुःखितम्॥ पितरं दुःखिततरो गोविन्दो वाक्यमब्रवीत्। न तेन विकृतं वक्त्रं कृतं संग्राममूर्धनि॥ न पृष्ठत: कृतश्चापि संग्रामस्तेन दुस्तरः।
en: His father who, from excess of grief, bewailed thus, Govinda, more afflicted than he, answered in these words, His face did not become cheerless as he fought in the van of battle. Dreadful though that battle was, he diu not turn his back upon it.

sa: पूज्या लालयितव्याश्च स्त्रियो नित्यं जनाधिप। स्त्रियो यत्र च पूज्यन्ते रमन्ते तत्र देवताः॥
en: on Women, O king should always be adored and treated with love. There where women are treated with honour, the very gods are said to be propitiated.

sa: त्वं हि यज्ञोऽक्षरः सर्वस्त्वं धर्मस्त्वं प्रजापतिः। त्वं गतिः सर्वभूतानामिति मे निश्चिता मतिः॥
en: You Sacrifice! You the Indestructible! You are this All! You are Virtue! You are Prajapati! You are the goal of all creatures! This is iny certain conclusion.

sa: निषादाश्च दिवं जग्मुस्ते च मत्स्या जनाधिप। नहुषोऽपि वरं लब्वा प्रविवेश स्वकं पुरम्॥
en: The Nishadas all ascended to heaven, as also the fishes they had caught, O king, king Nahusha too, having got those valuable boons, entered his own city.

sa: सोऽहं पुनः पुनश्चैव शिरसावनतोऽनघाः। गान्धार्या सहितं तन्मां समनुज्ञातुमर्हथ॥
en: You sinless ones, I with Gandhari, repeatedly solicit you with bent heads, You should all grant us permission.

sa: क्रोशन्त्यो यस्य वै राष्ट्राधियन्ते तरसा स्त्रियः। क्रोशतां पतिपुत्राणां मृतोऽसौ न च जीवति॥
en: That king is more dead than alive in whose kingdom women are easily abducted from their husbands and sons uttering cries and groans of indignation and grief.

sa: स्फ्यश्च कूर्चश्च सौवर्णो यच्चान्यदपि कौरव॥ तत्र योग्यं भवेत् किंचिद् रौक्मं तत् क्रियतामिति।
en: Let the Sphya and the Kurcha and all the other articles that, o you of Kuru's race, may be necessary for your sacrifice, be made of gold.

sa: स राजर्षिर्गत: स्वर्ग कर्मणा तेन शाश्वतम्। शरणागतेषु चैवं त्वं कुरु सर्वं युधिष्ठिर॥
en: Through the merit of his act the royal sage Shivi proceeded to eternal Heaven. Do you also, O Yudhishthira, act thus towards those who seek your protection.

sa: आवयोरनृतं प्राह यस्तस्याभूद् द्विजस्य वै। विपुलस्य परे लोके या गतिः सा भवेदिति॥
en: Their oath was this That one among us two who speaks falsely, shall, in the next world, meet with the end which will be the twiceborn Vipula's.

sa: नागलोकमुत्तङ्कस्तु प्रेक्ष्य दीनोऽभवत् तदा। निराशश्चाभवत् तत्र कुण्डलाहरणे पुनः॥
en: Seeing the regions of the Nagas, Utanka became very dispirited. Indeed, he despaired of getting back the ear-rings.

sa: तथैवास्यविजः सर्वे तुल्यवेषा विशाम्पते। बभूवुरर्जुनश्चापि प्रदीप्त इव पावकः॥
en: All his Ritvijas also, O king, were clad in similar dresses. Arjuna also shone like a burning fire.

sa: नारद उवाच यदृच्छया शक्रसदो गत्वा शक्रं शचीपतिम्। दृष्टवानस्मि राजर्षे तत्र पाण्डुं नराधिपम्॥
en: Going at my will to the palace of Shakra, I have seen Shakara the lord of Sachi; and there, O royal sage, I have seen king Pandu.

sa: इतो हि नागलोको वै योजनानि सहस्रशः। न दण्डकाष्ठसाध्यं च मन्ये कार्यमिदं तव॥
en: The regions of the Nagas are thousands of Yojanas removed from this place. I think that your purpose is impossible of being achieved with your walking staff.

sa: नहुष उवाच कोटिः प्रदीयतां मूल्यं निषादेभ्यः पुरोहित। यदेतदपि नो मूल्यमतो भूयः प्रदीयताम्॥
en: Nabusha said Let my priest give to these Nishadas a crore of coins. If even this does not cover your value, let more be paid to them.

sa: ततो युधिष्ठिरः प्राह पाण्डवान् पुरुषर्षभा पितामहस्य यद् वाक्यं तद् वो रोचत्विति प्रभुः।।४३
en: Then, O foremost of men, Yudhishthira, addressing all the other sons of Pandu, said to them Let the words which our grandfather has said, command your faith.'

sa: भीष्म उवाच एतावदुक्त्वा स तदा तूष्णीमासीद् भृगूत्तमः। अथ सूर्योऽददत् तस्मै छत्रोपानहमाशु वै॥
en: Bhishma said So saying, that exceilent descendant of Bhrigu remained silent for some time, and the Sun immediately gave him an umbrella and a pair of sandals,

sa: यश्च कश्चिन्नरः किंचिदप्रियं वाम्बिकासुते॥ कुरुते द्वेष्यतामेति स कौन्तेयस्य धीमतः। न राज्ञो धृतराष्ट्रस्य न च दुर्योधनस्य वै॥ उवाच दुष्कृतं कश्चिद् युधिष्ठिरभयानरः।
en: If any man did nay thing that was not liked by the son of Ambika, he became thereby an object of hatred to the intelligent son of Kunti. Indeed, through fear of Yudhishthira nobody could talk of the evil deeds of either Duryodhana or Dhritarashtra.

sa: अत्र गाथा भूमिगीताः कीर्तयन्ति पुराविदः। याः श्रुत्वा जामदग्त्येन दत्ता भूः काश्यपाय वै॥
en: Those persons conversant with ancient history sing this verse regarding the gift of earth. Heaving that verse Jamadagni's son (Rama) gave away the whole Earth to Kashyapa.

sa: इषीकां च यथा मुजात् कश्चिनिष्कृष्य दर्शयेत्। योगी निष्कृष्य चात्मानं तथा पश्यति देहतः॥
en: As one sees the fibrous pith after extracting it from a blade of the Saccharum Munja, so the Yogin sees the Soul, extracting it from the body.

sa: भीमं च बलिनां श्रेष्ठं सन्त्वयामास पार्थिवः॥ स चास्य सम्यङ् मेधावी प्रत्यपद्यत वीर्यवान्।
en: The king comforted Bhima, that foremost of all persons gifted with great strength. Gifted with great energy and great intelligence, Bhima showed his sub-missiveness to the king.

sa: क्षत्रियाणां प्रतपतां तेजसा च बलेन च। ब्राह्मणेष्वेव शाम्यन्ति तेजांसि च तपांसि च॥
en: The energy and penances of those Kshatriyas who blaze forth with energy and power, become powerless and neutralised when they come in in contact with the Brahmanas.

sa: महेश्वर उवाच नेत्रे मे संवृते देवि त्वया बाल्यादनिन्दिते। नष्टलोकस्तदा लोकः क्षणेन समपद्यत॥
en: Maheshvara said O goddess without any fault, for your having covered my eyes through an act of indiscretion, the universe became in a moment devoid of light.

sa: संस्थाप्यैवं तस्य राज्ञस्तं यज्ञं शक्रतेजसः॥ व्यासः स शिष्यो भगवान् वर्धयामासं तं नृपम्।
en: Having thus completed the sacrifice of that monarch who was gifted with the energy of Shakra himself, the illustrious Vyasa with his disciples eulogised the king greatly.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच शुश्रूषे तस्य धर्मज्ञ राजर्षेः परिकीर्तनम्। द्वैपायन मरुत्तस्य कथां प्रबूहि मेऽनघ॥
en: Yudhishthira said O righteous one, I wish to hear the history of that royal sage Marutta. Do you ( Dvaipayana, describe this to me, O sinless one.

sa: इत्युक्तः स तपो घोरं जामदग्न्यः पितामहैः। आस्थितः सुमहाभागो ययौ सिद्धिं च दुर्गमाम्॥
en: Thus addressed by his grandfathers, Jamadagni's son performed the austcrest penances, and having practised then, that highly blessed one acquired that success which is difficult to recall.

sa: यदा परे च बलिन: स्वपक्षश्चैव दुर्बलः। सार्धं विद्वांस्तदा क्षीणः परैः संधि समाश्रयेत्॥
en: When the enemy is strong and one's own side is weak, then the weak king, if he has intelligence, should try to make peace with the enemy.

sa: दुर्योधनेन पृथिवी क्षयिता वित्तकारणात्। कोशश्चापि विशीर्णोऽसौ धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दुर्मतेः॥
en: Duryodhana had wasted the Earth for money; and the treasury of that wicked son of Dhritarashtra is empty.

sa: आकाशस्य गुणो ह्येष श्रोत्रेण च स गृह्यते। श्रोत्रस्थाश्च दिशः सर्वाः शब्दज्ञाने प्रकीर्तिताः॥
en: The quality of a ether is sound. That is seized by the car. All the quarters, which live in the ear, have been appointed in apprehending sound.

sa: सूर्य उवाच असंशयं मां विप्रर्षे भेत्स्यसे धन्विनां वर। अपकारिणं मां विद्धि भगवञ्छरणागतम्॥
en: Surya said O twiceborn Rishi, forsooth, you know me, O best of archers! But, O holy one, though I have offended, see I pray for your protection.

sa: यजस्व वाजिमेधेन विधिवद् दक्षिणावता। बहुकामान्नवित्तेन रामो दाशरथिर्यथा॥ यथा च भरतो राजा दौष्यन्तिः पृथिवीपतिः। शाकुन्तलो महावीर्यस्तव पूर्वपितामहः॥
en: And as Dasharatha's son, Rama or as Dushyanta's and Shakuntala's son your ancestor, the lord of the Earth, thc exceedingly powerful king Bharata, had done, do you according to the ordinance celebrate the HorseSacrifice with presents.

sa: ब्राह्मणा यं प्रशंसन्ति स मनुष्यः प्रवर्धते। अथ यो ब्राह्मणान् क्रुष्टः पराभवति सोऽचिरात्॥२५
en: That man really grows in prosperity who is praised by the Brahmanas who are higher than those who are regarded superior to all men high or low.

sa: ततः स्त्रियः कौरवपाण्डवानां याश्चापराः कौरवराजवंश्याः। तासां नादः प्रादुरासीत् तदानीं वैचित्रवीर्ये नृपतौ प्रयाते॥
en: When the royal son of Vichitravirya thus started, the Pandava and the Kaurava ladies as also other women belonging to the Kaurava race, began to bewail aloud.

sa: नैव ते निष्ठितं कर्म नैव ते शत्रवो जिताः। कथं शत्रु शरीरस्थमात्मनो नावबुध्यसे॥
en: Your deed has not yet been destroyed nor have your enemies been subjugated, for you do not yet know the enemies that live within your own body.

sa: न हि देवा न गन्धर्वा न मनुष्या भगीरथ। आयान्त्यतप्ततपसः कथं वै त्वमिहागतः॥
en: Neither the celestials, nor Gandharvas, nor mankind, o Bhagiratha, succeed in coming here without having performed the severest austerities. How, indeed, have you come by this region.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच इत्युक्त्वा स तदा वाक्यं मां पार्थ द्विजसत्तमः। मोक्षधर्माश्रितः सम्यक् तत्रैवान्तरधीयत॥
en: Vasudeva said O'son of Pritha having said these words to me, on that occasion, about the Religion of Emancipation, that best of Brahmanas disappeared then and there.

sa: सर्वमेतद्धि यस्मात् ये दत्तं शुद्धेन चेतसा॥ कृच्छ्रकाले ततः स्वर्गो विजितः कर्मणा त्वया।
en: Since you have made this gift, in a season of great difficulty, with a pure heart, you have, by this act of yours, conquered the celestial region.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो राजा पाण्डवो हृष्टरूप: श्रुत्वा वाक्यं सत्यवत्याः सुतस्य। मनश्चक्रे तेन वित्तेन यष्टुं ततोऽमात्यैर्मन्त्रयामास भूयः॥
en: Vaishmpayana said Then the Pandava prince Yudhishthira was delighted on hearing this speech of the son of Satyavati (Vyasa), and desirous of celebrating his sacrifice with those riches, he consulted again and again with his ministers.

sa: पाण्डवास्त्वभितो मातुर्धरण्यां सुषुपुस्तदा। उत्सृज्य तु महार्हाणि शयनानि नराधिप।॥
en: The Pandavas, O king, leaving costly beds, laid themselves down, near their in other, on the naked earth.

sa: ये च ते पुरुषा विप्र अक्षैर्दीव्यन्ति हृष्टवत्। ऋतूंस्तानभिजानीहि ते ते जानन्ति दुष्कृतम्॥
en: Those other men (six in number) whom, O learned Brahmana, you saw playing cheerfully at dice, are the six Seasons. They also are acquainted with your sins.

sa: आहारश्चाप्यसंपूर्णो ममायं पुरुषाधम। स्वयं प्रविष्टोऽद्य मुखं कथमासाद्य दुर्मते॥
en: O vile man, I am fully fed. How shall you, of your own accord, enter into my mouth?

sa: हाहाकारः समभवत्तत्र तत्र सहस्रशः। अन्योऽन्यं छिन्दतां शस्त्रैरादित्ये लोहितायति॥
en: When the sun grew red, the piteous cries of distress issued from everywhere and from the dying Asuras.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच जीवितं प्रतिपद्यस्व गच्छ गन्धर्व मा शुचः। प्रदिशत्यभयं तेऽद्य कुरुराजो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: Arjuna said : O Gandharva, take your life. Go hence and do not grieve. The king of the Kurus, Yudhishthira others me today to show you mercy.

sa: ददृशातेऽथ ते तत्र समुद्र निधिमम्भसाम्। महान्तमुदकागाधं क्षोभ्यमाणं महास्वनम्॥
en: On their way they saw the great ocean, vast and deep, agitated by wind, making a tremendous roar.

sa: यदाश्रौषं वाहनेष्वक्षमेषु रथोपस्थे तिष्ठता पाण्डवेन। सर्वान् योधान् वारितानर्जुनेन तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Arjuna had kept back all is assailants when his horses were taken away for drink.

sa: यदाश्रौषं वासुदेवे प्रयाते रथस्यैकामग्रतस्तिष्ठमानाम्। आर्ती पृथां सान्त्वितां केशवेन तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Kunti had received consolation from him when she stood near his car, weeping in sorrow.

sa: यच किंचित् सर्वगतं भूमौ वा यदि वा दिवि। तस्याहमीश्वरो नित्यं तुष्टेनोक्तः स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: The Self created (Brahma) himself, being pleased with me said that I was the lord of that which was in all things on earth or in heaven.

sa: न निवर्तयितुं शक्यं यदुक्तं ब्रह्मवादिना। त्वमस्मान् मानुषी भूत्वा सृज पुत्रान् वसून् भुवि॥१५
en: We are not able to frustrate what has been said by that Brahma-knowing Rishi. Kindly make us, the Vasus, your sons by becoming a woman on earth.

sa: ग्रामणीश्च महीपालानेष जित्वा महाबलः। भ्रातृभिः सहितो वीरस्त्रीन् मेधानाहरिष्यति॥
en: This greatly powerful hero with his brothers will conquer all the weak kings and perform three great horse-sacrifices.

sa: मनोरमं महेष्वासो विवेश वनमुत्तमम्। मारुताकलितास्तत्र द्रुमाः कुसुमशाखिनः॥ पुष्पवृष्टिं विचित्रां तु व्यसृजंस्ते पुनः पुनः। दिवःस्पृशोऽथ संघुष्टाः पक्षिभिर्मधुरस्वनैः॥
en: Such was the charming and excellent forest that the great bow-man (Dushyanta) entered. The trees, decked with flowers and waved with the soft breeze. Showered sweet flowers, again and again, on the head of the king.

sa: प्रतिजग्राह तान् सर्वान् शिष्यत्वेन महायशाः। शिक्षयामास च द्रोणो धनुर्वेदमशेषतः॥ तेऽचिरेणैव कालेन सर्वशस्त्रविशारदाः। बभूवः कौरवा राजन् पाण्डवश्चामितौजसः॥
en: Drona taught them the science of arms in all its branches. O king, the immeasurably powerful Pandavas and the Kurus became with in a very short time experts in the use of all kinds of weapons.

sa: स कदाचिन्महाराज ददर्श परमां स्त्रियम्। जाज्वल्यमानां वपुषा साक्षाच्छ्रियमिवापराम्॥
en: There did the great king meet with one day a lovely damsel of blazing beauty like Sree herself.

sa: स सर्वं क्षत्रमुत्साद्य स्ववीर्येणानलद्युतिः। समन्तपञ्चके पञ्च चकार रौधिरान्ह्रदान॥
en: That fiery Rama, after destroying the Kshatriyas by his own prowess, made five lakes of blood at Samantapanchaka.

sa: ततस्तीरमुपागम्य भागीरथ्याः स लक्ष्मणः। उवाच मैथिली वाक्यं प्राञ्जलिर्बाष्पसंवृतः॥
en: Thereupon having reached the other side of Bhāgirathi, Lakşmaņa, with subdued voice and folded palms, said to Sītā.

sa: देवापि खलु बाल एवारण्यं विवेश। शान्तनुस्तु महीपालो बभूव॥
en: Devapi retired into a forest as a hermit when he was still a boy. Therefore, Shantanu became king.

sa: के सदस्या बभूवुश्च सर्पसत्रे सुदारुणे। विषादजननेऽत्यर्थं पन्नगानां महाभये॥
en: Who became the Sadasyas in that terrible Snake-sacrifice, so fearful to the snakes and so sorrowful to them?

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्ता ततः कुन्ती पाण्डुं परपुरंजयम्। प्रत्युवाच वरारोहा भर्तुः प्रियहिते रता॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed by that subjugator of hostile cities, Pandu, the beautiful Kunti, ever engaged in doing good to her husband, thus replied-

sa: यक्षा: साध्याः पिशाचाश्च गुह्यकाः पितरस्तथा। ततः प्रसूता विद्वांसः शिष्टा ब्रह्मर्षि-सत्तमाः॥ राजर्षयश्च बहवः सर्वैः समुदिता गुणैः। आपो द्यौः पृथिवी वायुरन्तरिक्षं दिशस्तथा॥
en: The Yakshas, the Sadhyas, the Pisachas, the Guhyakas and the Pitris. Then were produced the wise and the most holy Brahmarshi and the numerous Rajarshis, distinguished for every noble quality, then the water, the heavens, the earth, the sky and the points of the heavens.

sa: भुक्त एव तु कौन्तेयो नास्यादन्यत्र वर्तते। हस्तस्तेजस्विनस्तस्य अनुग्रहणकारणात्॥
en: The effulgent son of Kunti, (Arjuna) continued eating the dark, his hand from habit going to his mouth.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्ा त्वब्रवीद् राजा कस्य पुत्रोऽसि नाम किम्। उवाच तं पाण्डवोऽहं कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Having heard this, the king said “Whose son are you and what is your name?" He (Arjuna) replied, “I am the Pandava, the son of Kunti, Dhananjaya".

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः स धर्मात्मा ब्राह्मणः शुभकर्मकृत्। प्रसादं कृतवान् वीर रविसोमसमप्रभः॥ उच्यते।
en: Vaishampayana said : O hero, having been thus addressed, that virtuous-minded Brahmana of good deeds, as effulgent as the sun or the Moon, became propitious to them.

sa: तमुवाचापसपैति द्रोणोऽप्रीतमना इव। नैतच्छक्यं त्वया वेळू लक्ष्यमित्येव कुत्सयन्॥
en: Drona, being displeased, reproachingly told him, “Stand back. It is not for you to strike at this aim."

sa: भासं पश्यसि यद्येनं तथा ब्रूहि पुनर्वचः। शिरः पश्यामि भासस्य न गात्रमिति सोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: "If you see the bird, describe it to me." He (Arjuna) again replied, “I see the head of the bird, but I do not see its body."

sa: अनुग्रहार्थं जगतः सर्वकामदुहां वरा। तां लेभे गां तु धर्मात्मा होमधेनुं स वारुणिः॥
en: The virtuous-minded son of Varuna, obtained that best of kine, capable of granting every desire, for the purpose of his Homa rites and for benefiting the world,

sa: ततो वसिष्ठस्तेजस्वी सर्व निरवशेषतः। चकार विधिवद्धर्म माहाप्रस्थानिक विधिम्॥
en: There upon the highly effulgent Vasiştha arranged duly all the ceremonies necessary for going to the next world.

sa: अवगाढमथो द्रोणं सलिले सलिलेचरः। ग्राहो जग्राह बलवाञ्जङ्घान्ते कालचोदितः॥
en: When Drona was bathing, a strong alligator, as it sent by Death himself, seized him at the thigh.

sa: स्ववीर्यं क्षत्रियाणां तु बाह्वोर्धाता न्यवेशयत्। तद् दिदृक्षसि चेद् राजन् द्रष्टास्यद्य न संशयः॥
en: O king, the creator has placed his own energy in the arms of the Kshatriya. If you desire to see it, you will certainly see it today.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा भरतेनोक्तं दृष्ट्वा चापि ह्यधोमुखान्। पौरान्दुःखेन संतप्तान्वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing those words of Bharata and beholding the subjects stricken with sorrow having their heads downwards, Vasistha said.

sa: अलंकृताः कुमाराश्च वृष्णीनां सुमहौजसाम्। यानैर्हाटकचित्रैश्च चर्यन्ते स्म सर्वशः॥
en: The effulgent youths of the Vrishni race, adorned with ornaments and riding on golden cars, looked handsome everywhere.

sa: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच स्नातकान् ब्राह्मणान् राजन् विद्ध्यस्मांस्त्वं नराधिप। स्नातकव्रतिनो राजन् ब्राह्मणाः क्षत्रिया विशः॥
en: Krishna said O king, know us for Snataka Brahmanas. O king of men, O monarch, Brahmanas, Kshatriyas and Vaishyas are all competent to observe the Snataka vow.

sa: कुरुजाङ्गलमुख्येषु राष्ट्रेषु नगरेषु च। अनु त्वमभिषिच्यस्व नृपति धर्मवत्सला॥
en: Be installed with the virtue-loving king (Yudhishthira) as the queen of the kingdom and the capital of Kurujangala.

sa: आसनानि विचित्राणि रुचिराणि महीपतिः। प्रयत्नोपहितानि स्म दृष्ट्वा विस्मयमागमत्॥
en: The king was much astonished to see the beautiful carpets which these Brahmanas offered him (for his seat).

sa: भवतो वपुष्टमायां द्वौ पुत्रौ जज्ञाते; शतानीक: शकुकर्णश्च। शतानीकस्य वैदेह्यां पुत्र उत्पन्नोऽश्वमेधदत्त इति॥
en: You have begotten two sons on your wife Vapushtama, named Shatanika and Shankukarna. And Shatanika has also begotten a son on the princess of Videha, named Ashvamedhadatta.

sa: कामश्च योऽसौ दुपदस्य राज्ञः स चापि सम्पत्स्यति पार्थिवस्य। मिमामहं ब्राह्मण साधु मन्ये॥
en: The desire that the king Drupada has all along entertained will (surely) be fulfilled, for O Brahmana, I believe this princess in endued with all auspicious marks.

sa: पाण्डुर्हि राजा द्रुपदस्य राज्ञः प्रियः सखा चात्मसमो बभूव। तस्यैष कामो दुहिता ममेयं स्नुषां प्रदास्यामि हि कौरवाय॥
en: King Pandu was a dear friend of king Draupada who regarded him as his counter self. He had all along cherished the desire of bestowing his this daughter on that Kuru prince (Pandu) as his daughter-in-law.

sa: स निरीक्ष्य महाबाहुः सर्वतो रङ्गमण्डलम्। प्रणाम द्रोणकृपयो त्यादृतमिवाकरोत्॥
en: The mighty armed (hero) looked all around the arena and bowed rather with indifference to Drona and Kripa.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतदाख्याय सा देवी तत्रैवान्तरधीयत। आदाय च कुमार तं जगामाथ यथेप्सितम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having said this, the goddess disappeared then and there. Taking her son with her, she went away to the place she wished to go.

sa: यथा हि लक्ष्यं निहतं धनुश्च सज्यं कृतं तेन तथा प्रसा। यथा हि भापन्ति परस्परं ते छन्ना ध्रुवं ते प्रचरन्ति पार्थाः॥
en: From the way in which the mark was shot down by the youth, the strength with which the bow was stringed by him and the manner in which they talked to one another, it is certain they are the sons of Pritha wandering in disguise.

sa: तेन स्म तपसो लोभात्कृच्छ्रमापादिता वयम्। न तस्यभार्या पुत्रो वा बान्धवो वाऽस्ति कश्चन।॥
en: But from his temptation for the merits of asceticism we have been reduced to this state. He was no wife and no son, no friend, no relatives.

sa: तं दृष्ट्वा सूतपुत्रोऽयमिति संचिन्त्य पाण्डवः। भीमसेनस्तदा वाक्यमब्रवीत् प्रहसन्निव॥
en: Seeing him (Adhiratha) the Pandavas considered him to be a son of a charioteer and Bhishma jeeringly said,

sa: मनसा कर्मणा वाचा यथा रामं समर्चये। तथा मे माधवी देवी विवरं दातुमर्हति॥
en: I have always with my mind, body and words prayed for Rāma's well-being and by virtue hereof may the goddess Vasundhară give me room in her womb.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः स भगवान् धूमकेतुर्हताशनः। चिन्तयामास वरुणं लोकपालं दिदृक्षया॥ आदित्यमुदके देवं निवसन्तं जलेश्वरम्। स च तच्चिन्तितं ज्ञात्वा दर्शयामास पावकम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having been thus addressed, the illustrious smoke-banned (deity) Agni recollected Varuna, the protector of the world, the son of Aditi and the lord of waters having his home in the waters, He too knowing that he was thought of, appeared before Agni.

sa: ततस्तापसरूपेण प्राहिणोत्स भुजंगमान्। फलदर्भोदकं गृह्य राज्ञे नागोऽथ तक्षकः॥
en: Takshaka then sent some snakes in the guise of Brahmanas with fruits Kusha grass and water as presents.

sa: ततः शिष्यान् समानीय आचार्योऽर्थमचोदयत्। द्रोणः सर्वानशेषेण दक्षिणार्थं महीपते॥
en: O king, one day assembling his pupils together, the preceptor Drona asked his Dakshina from them all, saying-

sa: अर्क इत्यभिविख्यातो यस्तु दानवपुङ्गवः। ऋषिको नाम राजर्षिर्बभूव नृपसत्तमः॥
en: O king, that best of Danavas, who was known as Arka, became the royal sage Rishika on earth.

sa: सुप्रणीतो बलौधो हि कुरुते कार्यमुत्तमम्। अंधं बलं जडं प्राहुः प्रणेतव्यं विचक्षणैः॥ :॥
en: Troops when led properly do excellent service. The wise men say that troops without a leader is useless. Therefore, troops should be (always) led by experienced leaders.

sa: अथवा यदि कन्येयं न च कञ्चिद् बुभूपति। अग्नावेनां परिक्षिप्य याम राष्ट्राणि पार्थिवाः॥
en: O kings, if this maiden does not desire to select one of us as her husband, let us throw her into fire and return to our kingdoms.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः स भगवान् दाशार्हेणार्जुनेन च। तैजसं रूपमास्थाया दावं दग्धुं प्रचक्रमे॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Dasharha (Krishna) and Arjuna, the illustrious (Agni) put forth his most energetic form and he then prepared himself to consume that forest.

sa: संनिबद्धं हि श्लोकानां चतुर्विंशत्सहस्रकम्। उपाख्यानशतं चैव भार्गवेण तपस्विना॥
en: The great ascetic Vālmīki has composed this poem consisting of a hundred stories and twenty four thousand slokas.

sa: परं हीदं भारतं भगवता व्यासेन प्रोक्तं पावनं ये ब्राह्मणादयो वर्णाः श्रद्दधाना अमत्सरा मैत्रा वेदसम्पन्नाः श्रोष्यन्ति, तेऽपि स्वर्गजितः सुकृतिनोऽशोच्याः कृताकृते भवन्ति॥
en: This holy history, Bharata, has been told by the illustrious Vyasa. The Brahmanas, learned in the Vedas and all those men who hear it recited with reverence and without malice, conquer the heavens and earn great virtues. Though sinning, he is not disrespected by any.

sa: प्रविष्टौ भारती सेनामप्रधृष्यां सुरैरपि। संशप्तकावशेषं च कृतं निःशेषमाहवे॥
en: Entered into the Kaurava ranks, impenetrable even by the celestial; the destruction of the rest of the Sansaptakas.

sa: हरस्त्वरिहरो वीर आसीद्यो दानवोत्तमः। सुबाहुरिति विख्यातः श्रीमानासीत्स पार्थिवः॥
en: That best of Danavas, known as the heroic Hara, became the famous and fortunate king Subahu on earth.

sa: एवं ब्रुवन्नेव मुनिः सवकार्यमिव चिन्तयन्। विसर्जयामास नृपं बृहद्रथमथारिहन्॥
en: Having said this, the Rishi, thinking of his own business, dismissed that layer of foes, the king Brihadratha.

sa: समवेतास्त्रयः शूरा भूरिभूरिश्रवाः शलः। सुदक्षिणश्च काम्बोजो दृढधन्वा च
en: All great heroic and car-warriors, all these have assembled here. Bhuri, Bhurishrava, Sala, Sudakshina, Kamboja, the Paurava Dridadhnava,

sa: अन्येऽपि ह्याश्रमाः सन्ति ये शक्या भरतर्षभ। आवाभ्यां धर्मपत्नीभ्यां सह तप्तुं तपो महत्॥
en: “O best of the Bharata race, there are many other Ashramas (modes of life) in which you can perform with us, your lawfully wedded wives, great asceticism.

sa: ररास गगनं कृत्स्नमुत्पातजलदैरिवा ततः कृष्णो महाबाहुः स्वतेजोभास्वरं महत्॥
en: The mighty-armed Krishna (dark) Keshava hurled at them for their destruction his large, fierce and greatly effulgent discuss.

sa: तमेव कालं मित्रोऽपि वरुणत्वमकारयत्। क्षीरोदेन सहोपेतः पूज्यमानः सुरेश्वरैः॥
en: At that time Mitra in conjunction with Varuņa was reigning in Varuna's kingdom being worshipped by all celestials.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रस्य चात्रैव कौरवायोधनं तथा। सान्तःपुरस्य गमनं शोकार्तस्य प्रकीर्तितम्॥
en: Then is described the journey of Dhritarashtra with the ladies of his house to the field of battle.

sa: गृहे गृहे मनुष्याणां नित्यं तिष्ठामि राक्षसी। गृहदेवीति नाम्ना वै पुरा सृष्टा स्वयंभुवा॥
en: I am a Rakshasi who always wander from house to house of men. I was formerly created by the self-create (Brahma) and was named Grihadevi (household goddess).

sa: उदीचीमर्जुनो वीरः प्रतीची नकुलस्तथा। दक्षिणां सहदेवस्तु विजिग्ये परवीरहा॥
en: The heroic Arjuna conquered the North; Nakula the West and the slayer of heroic foes, Sahadeva, the South.

sa: राजोवाच का त्वं कमलगर्भाभे मम पुत्रप्रदायिनी। कामया ब्रूहि कल्याणि देवता प्रतिभासि मे॥
en: “O lotus-complexioned lady, who are you that give me the child? O blessed lady, you appear to me as a goddess roaming (over the earth) at pleasure."

sa: तदाख्यातं तु भीष्माय विदुराय च धीमते। यस्मिन्नहनि दुर्धर्षो जज्ञे दुर्योधनस्तदा॥ तस्मिन्नेव महाबाहुर्जज्ञे भीमोऽपि वीर्यवान्। स जातमात्र एवाथ धृतराष्ट्रसुतो नृप॥ रासभारावसदृशं रुराव च ननाद च। तं खरा: प्रत्यभाषन्त गृध्रगोमायुवायसाः॥
en: The news of Duryodhana's birth was carried to Bhishma and the wise Vidura. On the day when haughty Duryodhana was born, on that very day was born mighty armed and greatly powerful Bhima. O king, as soon as that son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana) was born, he roared and brayed like an ass, Hearing that sound, the arsons vultures, jackals and crows spontaneously cried.

sa: प्रहितो विदुरेणास्मि खनकः कुशलो ह्यहम्। पाण्डवानां प्रियं कार्यमिति किं करवाणि वः॥ प्रच्छन्नं विदुरेणोक्तः श्रेयस्त्वमिति पाण्डवान्। प्रतिपादय विश्वासादिति किं करवाणि वः॥
en: "I have been sent by Vidura; I am wellskilled in mining. Tell me what favourite works of the Pandavas I shall perform. He trusts me and has said to me in private, “Go to Pandavas and accomplish their good. what can I do for you?

sa: सौतिरुवाच संदिश्य पन्नगान्सर्वान्वासुकिः सुसमाहितः। स्वसारमुद्यम्य तदा जरत्कारुमृषि प्रति॥
en: Sauti said : Vasuki, wishing to bestow his sister on Rishi Jaratkaru, gave the snakes (all necessary) orders.

sa: सदृशीयं मम भवेद्यदि नान्यपरिग्रहः। इति बुद्धिंसमास्थाय जलात्कूलमुपागमत्॥ आश्रमं समुपागम्य ततस्ताः प्रमदोत्तमाः। शब्दापयत धर्मात्मा ताश्चैनं च ववन्दिरे॥
en: If she has not been married before then she is my worthy spouse. With this resolution Budha got up from the waters, and repairing to his hermitage, sent for the fair ones. they all saluted him.

sa: तपन्तं च तपस्तीव्रमम्भोमध्ये दुरासदम्। यशस्करं कामकरं कारुण्ये पर्यवस्थितम्॥
en: Having compassion for all creatures Budha, at that time, was performing, hard, glorious and wished-for austerities within waters.

sa: वसिष्ठश्च महाभागः सर्वमेतदवैक्षत। ज्ञानयोगेन महता तपसा च परंतप॥
en: O chastiser of foes, the illustrious Vasishtha immediately know all this by his great asceticism and spiritual sight.

sa: पाण्डोः कुन्त्यां च मात्र्यां च पुत्राः पञ्च महारथाः। देवेभ्यः समपद्यन्त संतानाय कुलस्य
en: Pandu had by his wives) Kunti and Madri five sons, all great car warriors, who were all begotten by celestial for the perpetuation of the (Kuru) dynasty.

sa: तथा पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुश्चैव महाक्रतुः। तत्राजग्मुरमित्रघ्न रक्षसां जीवितेप्सया॥
en: O chastiser of foes, there also came Pulaha, Kratu and Mahakratu with the desire of saving the Rakshasas.

sa: यस्मिन्क्षेप्स्यसि दुर्धर्षं स एको न भविष्यति। पुरा नाम च तस्यासीद्वसुषेण इति क्षितौ॥
en: At whoinever, O hero, you will hurt this weapon, he will certainly be killed. He (the son of Pritha) was previously known by the name of Vasushena,

sa: ननन्द माता कौसल्या तमप्रतिमतेजसम्। जयन्तमिव पौलोमी परिष्वज्य नरर्षभम्॥
en: Kausalya, in embracing her son of matchless prowess became as glad as Sachi on embracing Jayanta (her son).

sa: ततस्तीक्ष्णार्चिरभ्यागात् त्वरितो हव्यवाहनः। यत्र शाॉ बभूवुस्ते मन्दपालस्य पुत्रकाः॥
en: Then Agni in haste and with fearful flames came to the spot where the sons of Mandapala were.

sa: सौतिरुवाच तथैव कृत्वा विवरं प्रविश्य स प्रभुर्भुवो भुजगवराग्रजः स्थितः। बिभर्ति देवीं शिरसा महीमिमां समुद्रनेमिं परिगृह्य सर्वतः॥
en: Sauti said: The elder brother of the king of the snakes, entering into a hole, went to the other side of the earth. He held that goddess (earth) with her belt of seas all around her.

sa: जयत्सेनो खलु वैदर्भीमुपयेमे सुश्रवां नाम। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे अवाचीनः॥
en: Jayatsena married Sushrava, the daughter of the Vidarbha king and she gave birth to a son, named Avachina.

sa: व्यास उवाच जीवत्पुत्रि सुतस्तेऽयं धर्मनित्यो युधिष्ठिरः। धर्मेण पृथिवीं जित्वा महात्मा पुरुषर्षभः। पृथिव्यां पार्थिवान् सर्वान् प्रशासिष्यति धर्मराट्॥
en: Vyasa said: O daughter, live your this son, the illustrious and the best of men, Yudhisthira, ever devoted to virtue, conquering the word by his virtue will virtuously rule over all the kings of the world.

sa: अपश्यमानस्तं देशं घोरं पुत्रस्य राघव। विन्ध्यसैवलयोर्मध्ये राज्यं प्रादादरिंदम॥
en: Thereupon finding no other province worthy of Danda he allotted the region between Vihdhya and Saivala to him.

sa: यस्मिन् सर्वं सम्भवति यश्च सर्वत्र पूज्यते। यश्च सर्वेश्वरो राजा राजसूयं स विन्दति॥
en: He in whom every thing is possible he who is worshipped every where and he who is the king of all kings can alone perform this sacrifice.

sa: शोकेनाभिहतः सोऽथ विलपन्करुणं बहु। अब्रवीद्वचनं शोचन्धियां स्मृत्वा प्रमद्वराम्॥
en: Overwhelmed with grief, he indulged in much piteous lamentations. Remembering his beloved Pramadvara, he thus lamented in grief,

sa: अदृश्यन्ती तु तं दृष्ट्वा क्रूरकर्माणमग्रतः। भयसंविग्नया वाचा वसिष्ठमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Seeing that that king of cruel of cruel deeds, Adrishyanti spoke thus to Vasishtha in anxiety and fear,

sa: स ताभ्यां व्यचरत् सार्धं भार्याभ्यां राजसत्तमः। कुन्त्या माझ्या च राजेन्द्रो यथाकामं यथासुखम्॥
en: O king of kings, that best of kings (Pandu) then give himself up to enjoyments with his two wives, Kunti and Madri, at will and at pleasure.

sa: मम पन्था महाराज धर्म एष सनातनः। राज्ञा सर्वेषु धर्मेषु देयः पन्था द्विजातये॥
en: “O great king, this is my way. This is eternal religion. The king should yield the way to the Brahmanas according to all the precepts of religion.”

sa: शौनक उवाच श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यशेषेण कथामेतां मनोरमाम्। आस्तीकस्य पुराणाह्मणस्य यशस्विनः॥
en: Shaunaka said : I am desirous of hearing in detail the interesting story of Astika, the illustrious Brahmana.

sa: वेत्रकीयगृहे राजा नायं नयमिहास्थितः। उपायं तं न कुरुते यत्नादपि स मन्दधीः। अनामयं जनस्यास्य येन स्यादद्य शाश्वतम्॥
en: There is a king in a place called Vetrakiyagriha, but that foolish man does not know how to govern (his kingdom) and he does not take any step by which this country may be rendered safe.

sa: उवाच चैनं भूयोऽपि नारायणमिदं वचः। अजस्चामस्थ स्याममृतेन विनाऽप्यहम्॥
en: He again said to Narayana, “I want to be immortal and free from disease without drinking the Ambrosia."

sa: एवं दारक्रियाहेतोः प्रयतिष्ये पितामहाः। अनेन विधिना शश्वन्न करिष्येऽहमन्यथा।॥
en: O sires, I shall try to marry such a girl. Having said so, I shall not act otherwise.

sa: तत्राससाद क्षुधितं पुरुषादं वृकोदरः। भीमसेनो महाबाहुर्बकं नाम महाबलम्॥
en: It was here that the mighty-armed Bhima met with a greatly powerful and hungry maneating Rakshasa, named Baka.

sa: एवमुक्तः सुमन्त्रेण राजवेश्मनि लक्ष्मणः। प्रविश्य सीतामासाद्य व्याजहार नरर्षभः॥
en: Hearing the words of Sumantra, Laksmana, the foremost of men, approached Sītā in the inner apartment and said.

sa: ततः सिंहासनं हित्वा मेरुकूटमिवांशुमान्॥ पश्यतो मे तदा राम विमानादवरुह्य च। तं शवं भक्षयामास स स्वर्गी रघुनन्दन॥
en: O Rāma, the foremost of Raghu's race, like to the moon renouncing the summit of the Sumeru mount that celestial wight got down from his seat in the car and engaged in devouring the dead body.

sa: तस्मिन्प्रवृत्ते सत्रे तु सर्याणामन्तकाय वै। मोचयामास तान्नागानास्तीकः सुमहातपाः॥
en: When the sacrifice for the destruction of the snakes had begun, the great ascetic Astika rescued the Nagas,

sa: स तत्स्मृत्वा पितुर्वाक्यं भीमवेगोऽन्तरिक्षगः। नखेन गजमेकेन कूर्ममेकेन चाक्षिपत्॥
en: Remembering his father's words, the swiftflying great bird seized the elephant and the tortoise, one in each claw.

sa: पुरा त्रेतायुगे राम बभूव बहुविस्तरम्। समन्ताद्योजनशतं विमृगं पक्षिवर्जितम्॥
en: O Răma, in Tretāage, there was a huge forest extending over hundred Yojanas divested of animals and men.

sa: विभीषणश्च धर्मिष्ठ उपास्ते भ्रातरं प्रभुम्। हिमवान् पारियात्रश्च विन्ध्यकैलासमन्दराः॥
en: The virtuous Vibhishana wait upon his elder brother, the lord (Kubera). The (mountains) Himalayas, Paripatra, Vindhya, Kailasa, Mandara,

sa: तयोरन्यतरः श्रीमान्समुपैति महागजः। यस्य बृंहितशब्देन कूर्मोऽप्यन्तर्जलेशयः॥ उत्थितोऽसौ महाकायः कृत्स्नं विक्षोभयन्सरः। यं दृष्ट्वा वेष्टितकरः पतत्येष गजो जलम्॥
en: Look, the handsome elephant is coming to the lake. Hearing his roar the huge tortoise rises up, violently agitating the water of the lake; and seeing him the elephant, coiling his trunk, rushes into the water.

sa: तस्य कल्माषपादस्य यज्ञस्यायतनं शुभम्। आश्रमस्य समीपेऽस्मिन्यन्मां पृच्छसि राघव॥
en: O descendant of Raghu, the sacrificial ground of which you have asked me, belongs to the king Saudasa.

sa: ते भार्ये कश्यपस्यास्तां कद्रूश्च विनता च ह। प्रादात्ताभ्यां वरं प्रीतः प्रजापतिसमः पतिः॥
en: They were named Kadru and Vinata and they were the wives of Kashyapa. Their husband, who like Prajapati, having been pleased with them, gave each a boon

sa: प्रणष्टं शन्तनोर्वंशं समीक्ष्य पुनरुद्धृतम्। ततो निर्वचनं लोके सर्वराष्ट्रेष्ववर्तत॥
en: On seeing the restoration of the extinct dynasty of Shantanu, the following saying became current over all countries.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तः स नराधिपेन अवाक्शिरा दाशरथाय तस्मै। उवाच जातिं नृपपुङ्गवाय यत्कारणं चैव तपःप्रयत्नः॥
en: Hearing the words of Rāma, the ascetic, whose face was downwards, gave out his degraded birth and communicated to him for what he was performing ascetic observances.

sa: तथा शकुनयस्तस्यां विचित्रा मधुरस्वराः। अनिर्देश्या वपुष्मन्तः शतशोऽथ सहस्रशः॥
en: Hundreds and thousands of beautiful and variegated birds of various species always pour forth their melodies within them.

sa: संकीर्तनं च रामस्य सीतायाः प्रसवौ शुभौ॥ अर्धरात्रे तु शत्रुघ्नः शुश्राव सुमहत्प्रियम्। पर्णशालां ततो गत्वा मातर्दिष्ट्येति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Hearing the Sītā without any trouble had given birth to two sons and elderly female ascetics had been engaged in protecting them and bearing the chanting of Råma's glories in the midnight, Satrughna thought within himself.

sa: तत्र नानाजलचरा विनिष्पिष्टा महाद्रिणा। विलयं समुपाजग्मुः शतशो लवणाम्भसि॥
en: Various aquatic animals were crushed by the great mountain and gave up their lives in the salt sea.

sa: वारुणानि च भूतानि विविधानि महीधरः। पातालतलवासीनि विलयं समुपानयत्॥
en: Many denizens of the lower region and those of the land of Varuna were killed by the mountain.

sa: न च ते ब्राह्मणं हन्तुं कार्या बुद्धिः कथंचन। अवध्यः सर्वभूतानां ब्राह्मणो ह्यनलोपमः॥
en: But let not your heart be ever set on killing a Brahmana. A Brahmana is not to be killed amongst all creatures; he is like the fire.

sa: एतदत्यद्भुतं दृष्ट्वा दानवानां समुत्थितः। अमृतार्थे महान्नादो ममेदमिति जल्पताम्॥
en: Seeing this wonderful phenomenon, the Danavas raised a a great uproar for the Ambrosia, saying “It is mine."

sa: दिव्यात्मानो महात्मानः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वराः। भवन्तो भ्रातरः शूराः सर्वे सुचरितव्रताः॥ उत्तमां च मनोबुद्धिं भवतां भावितात्मनाम्। जानन्नपि च वः पार्थ कृतवानिह धर्षणाम्॥
en: Knowing too that you are high-souled, you are illustrious, you are the foremost of all wielders of arms, you, all brothers, are great heroes, you are virtuous and observant of vows, your understandings and hearts are excellent and your behaviour faultless, I still censured you.

sa: तत्रापि स महाभागः सुखभागभिजायते। न चेत् सम्बुध्यते तत्र गच्छत्यधमतां ततः॥ इह यत् क्रियते कर्म तत् परत्रोपभुज्यते। कर्मभूमिरियं ब्रह्मन् फलभूमिरसौ मता॥
en: O Rishi, then they obtain high fortune and happiness. If one however cannot acquire knowledge, he takes an inferior birth. The fruits of acts performed in this world are reaped in the next. O Brahmana, this worid has been declared to be one of acts.

sa: भूतं भव्यं भविष्यं च यच्च संख्यागतं गवाम्। न मेऽस्त्यविदितं किंचित् समन्ताद् दशयोजनम्॥
en: Nothing is unknown to me about the cows that live within ten Yojanas and whose tale has been taken in reference to their present past and future.

sa: श्वेता रजतसंकाशा रथे युज्यन्तु ते हयाः। ध्वजं च सिंहं सौवर्णमुच्छ्रयन्तु तव प्रभो॥
en: Let your horses, white as silver, be yoked to the cars and let your flag, having the emblem of a golden lion, he hoisted up, O lord.

sa: भवता सत्यमुक्तं तु सर्वमेतन्न संशयः। अतितीक्ष्णं तु ते वाक्यं ब्राह्मण्यादिति मे मतिः॥
en: Truth has been spoken by you; it is so; no doubt your words are very sharp; in my opinion that is so because you are a Brahmana.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच यथैवाहं नाभिचरे कदाचित् पतीन् मदाद् वै मनसापि जातु। तेनैव सत्येन वशीकृतं त्वां द्रष्टास्मि पापं परिकृष्यमाणम्॥
en: Draupadi said As I have never acted faithlessly towards my husbands, even at heart through infatuation; by virtue of that truth, O sinful one, I shall behold you overpowered and completely hurled down on the ground.

sa: अभिपत्य सुशर्माणं शरैरभ्याहन भृशम्। सुशर्मापि सुसंरब्धस्त्वरमाणो युधिष्ठिरम्॥ अविध्यन्नवभिर्बाणैश्चतुर्भिश्चतुरो हयान्। ततो राजन्नाशुकारी कुन्तीपुत्रो वृकोदरः॥ समासाद्य सुशर्माणमश्वानस्य व्यपोथयत्। पृष्ठगोपांश्च तस्याथ हत्वा परमसायकैः॥ अथास्य सारथिं क्रुद्धो रथोपस्थादपातयत्। चक्ररक्षश्च शूरो वै मदिराक्षोऽतिविश्रुतः॥
en: Susharma, too greatly enraged, with impetuosity pierced Yudhishthira with nine shafts and his four horses with four. Then 0 king, the quick-coursing son of Kunti, Vrikodara, nearing Susharma, assailed his horses. Having slain the soldiers that were in the rear with huge shafts, he, in anger, brought down his (Susharmas') charioteer from his car. The heroic protector of the wheels celebrated as Madiraksha,

sa: यदा रथे गाण्डिवं वासुदेवं दिव्यं शङ्ख पाञ्चजन्यं हयांश्च। तूणावक्षय्यौ देवदत्तं च मां च द्रष्ट्वा युद्धे धार्तराष्ट्रोऽन्वतप्स्यत्॥
en: When he sees in the chariot, the Gandiva bow, Vasudeva, the heavenly conch Panchajanya, my horses, the two arrow-holders which are never emptied, Devadatta and myself; then will the son of Dhritarashtra repent for the war.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच तथेत्युक्त्वा तु तं पाशं मुक्त्वा वैवस्वतो यमः। धर्मराजः प्रहृष्टात्मा सावित्रीमिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Markandeya said : Thereupon, Yama, the son of Vivasvata and the lord of justice saying "be it so" and unloosing his noose, cheerfully spoke to Savitri thus,

sa: प्रदायैषामुचितं तात राज्यं सुखी पुत्रैः सहितो मोदमानः। न देवानां नापि च मानुषाणां भविष्यसि त्वं तर्कणीयो नरेन्द्र॥
en: Giving back to them their rightful kingdom, O Sire, be happy with your sons and pass your time agreeably; O Lord of man, then will you not be mistrusted by the gods, nor by the men.

sa: ततस्तस्याश्रमं गत्वा रामस्थाक्लिष्टकर्मणः॥ चक्रतुस्तद् तथा सर्वमुभौ यत् पूर्वमन्त्रितम्।
en: Then having got to the hermitage of Rama of untiring action, they both did as was arranged previously.

sa: य एतद् वा भगवान् स नित्यो विकारयोगेन तथा च तच्छक्तिरिति स्म मन्यते तथार्थयोगे च भवन्ति वेदाः॥
en: The Supreme Being by his constant transformation creates this universe; the Vedas make it plain that the Supreme Being possesses the power (of constant transformation) and that He is the cause of transformation in this world.

sa: वर्धयन् दुहृदां प्रीतिं मां च शोकेन वर्धयन्। निहतो भीमसेनेन स्मर्ताऽसि वचनं पितुः॥
en: And enhancing the Joy of wicked hearted person as also my grief, when you will be slain by Bhimasena, you will remember the words of your father.

sa: देतद् विद्वन् साधनार्थं ब्रवीमि। एतद् राज्ञो भीष्मपुरोगमस्य मतं यद् वः शान्तिरिहोत्तमा स्यात्॥
en: If so requested they would give away their lives; why should not they do this which is, I say, O learned man, for the preservation of others.

sa: राक्षसाः पुरुषादाश्च पिशाचाश्च महाबलाः। सर्वे समेत्य राजानमभ्यषिञ्चन् दशाननम्॥
en: The man-eating and highly powerful Rakshasas and Pishachas, having assembled together, installed the ten-headed Ravana as their king.

sa: दीर्घा वेणी विधुन्वानः साधु रक्ते च वाससी। विधूय वेणी धावन्तमजानन्तोऽर्जुनं तदा॥ सैनिकाः प्राहसन् केचित् तथारूपमवेक्ष्य तम्। तं शीघ्रमभिधावन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य कुरवोऽब्रुवन्॥
en: His long braid of hair and pure white garments were fluttering in the air. Not knowing that Arjuna was running with his long braid of hair flowing and seeing him some soldiers burst out into laughter. And seeing him thus run quickly the Kurus said.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततः सा वीडिता बाला तदा सूर्यमथाब्रवीत्। एवमस्त्विति राजेन्द्र प्रस्थितं भूरिवर्चसम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Then, O king of kings, that maiden said bashfully to the highly resplendent Surya who was about to go away “may it be so."

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच अप्रैषीद् राजपुत्री मां सुराहारी तवान्तिकम्। पानमाहर मे क्षिप्रं पिपासा मेऽति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Draupadi said The princess has sent me to you for taking away wine; give it to me quickly, she said to ine she has a great thirst.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततो वैकर्तनं जित्वा पार्थो वैराटिमब्रवीत्। एतन्मां प्रापयानीकं यत्र तालो हिरण्मयः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon having vanquished Vaikartanas son (Karna), Arjuna said to Virata's son (Uttara). "Take me to that army where is seen the emblem of golden palmyra.

sa: खादाम पाटयामैनां तिलश: प्रविभज्य ताम्। येयं भर्तारमस्माकमवमन्येह जीवति॥
en: "Let us devour her; mangle her and tear her to pieces, who is living here despising our lord."

sa: तुल्ये प्रियाप्रिये यस्य सुखदुःखे तथैव च। अतीतानागते चोभे स वै सर्वधनी नरः॥
en: The man to whom the agreeable and the disagreeable, happiness and misery the past and the future are all alike, is enriched with all sorts of wealth.

sa: तपोधोरव्रता देवी कथं जेष्यसि पाण्डवम्॥ मन्त्री जनार्दनो यस्य भ्राता यस्य धनंजयः। सर्वशस्त्रभृतां श्रेष्ठः कथं जेष्यसि पाण्डवम्॥
en: That lady devoted to austere asceticismhow can you defeat that son of Pandu. Him whose adviser is Janardana, whose brother is Dhananjaya, the foremost among all wielders of weapon-how will you defeat that son of Pandu.

sa: अश्वानां प्रकृति वेद्मि विनयं चापि सर्वशः। दुष्टानां प्रतिपत्तिं च कृत्स्नं चैव चिकित्सितम्॥
en: I know the temper of horses, and the art of breaking them completely. I know how to correct the wicked steeds and the treatment of all kinds.

sa: यच्छक्यं ग्रसितुं चस्यं चस्तं परिणमेच्च यत्। हितं च परिणामे यत् तदाद्यं भूतिमिच्छता॥
en: One who desire prosperity, should swallow only that which can be swallowed and which, being swallowed, can be digested and may contribute to benefit in the end.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनः कृष्णं शकुनिश्चापि सौबलः। द्वितीयेन रथेनैनमन्वयातां परंतपम्॥
en: Duryodhana and Shakuni the son of Subala on a second car followed this chastiser of enemies, Krishna. as

sa: प्रतिजग्राह तं कर्णः प्रीयमाणो महारथः। महता शरवर्षेण वर्षमाणमिवाम्बुदम्॥
en: The mighty car-warrior Karna delightedly received it with a heavy downpour of arrows like a shower of clouds.

sa: द्वाःस्थ उवाच विदुरोऽयमनुप्राप्तो राजेन्द्र तव शासनात्। द्रष्टुमिच्छति ते पादौ किं करोतु प्रशाधिमाम्॥
en: The gate keeper said O chief among kings, Vidura, having come here at your command, desires to behold your feet. Command me what he is to do.

sa: अवज्ञाय तु यत् तेऽहं भोजनाद् व्यपरोपितः। तेन मे गौरवं नष्टं त्वतश्चास्माच्च वासव॥
